Find the questions people ask AI apps where your website is missing, then prepare original pages that answer them. Pick the competitors for this part from Part C's final list. Part A at a glance — 5 steps 1 ▶ Pick your website, country and AI app Open Semrush's AI Toolkit, type in the exact domain, set the filters once and write them down. 2 ▤ Write down today's numbers Save the starting score: visibility, mentions, cited pages. Same filters every time, or the comparison lies. 3 ⌕ Find questions people ask AI Topic Opportunities lists real questions, how often they're asked, and how hard each is to win. 4 ⊘ Find questions competitors answer but you don't Competitor Research > Missing prompts. Each gap is a page idea. 5 ✎ Write your own page, then check again Draft an original, fact-checked page. Get approval, publish, and re-check with the same filters after 7 days.

Gujlish summary: Pela sachi website, country ane AI platform select karo. Baseline metrics note karo. Topic Opportunities ane competitors na Missing prompts mathi useful topic shodho. AI jawab ke competitor nu lakhanu copy na karo. Original, fact-check karelu page draft karo. Approval pachhi publish karo ane 7 divas pachhi same filters sathe result check karo. AI citation ni koi guarantee nathi. Goal: Find questions where the website is missing from AI answers, then prepare useful, original pages that answer those questions. This SOP explains research and preparation. It is not permission to buy access, use paid credits or publish pages. Before starting Confirm the project domain, target audience, country and language. Use the project's agreed market; use Worldwide only when no specific market is required. Confirm the Semrush account and approved access route. The screen names below follow the user's Semrush notes. This SOP has not been checked in live Semrush. If a label or metric is unclear, mark it "Verify in Semrush" and ask instead of guessing. Confirm access, any credit cost and the scope of approval. If these are unclear, pause the affected action and ask. Do not switch accounts or spend credits without approval. Create a dated research record. Keep the original notes unchanged. Record the domain, country, language, platform filters, report date and tool data-update date. Example used in this SOP A home-organization website targets the US. A candidate question is "How do I make a weekly cleaning schedule?" Replace the website, market and question with the real project. All examples are illustrative, not live research results. The user's strategy: Work through all Topic Opportunities and competitor Missing prompts, capture the full response and website sources for research, then build pages that cover those questions. The steps below preserve that research flow. Added safeguards distinguish private research from publishable content, require original writing and flag overlap before a new page is created. Expected outputs A baseline record, a deduplicated opportunity list, a source-backed brief for each selected page, an approved publishing record and a seven-day review. If the tool has no usable data, report that result instead of inventing metrics or topics.

Purpose: Save a consistent starting point so later comparisons use the same domain and filters. Open AI Visibility > Visibility Overview. Enter the exact project domain. Select the agreed country and platform filters. Record them before collecting numbers. Record the visibility score and the displayed metrics: Mentions, Citations and Cited Pages. Include any change values, comparison period and data-update date shown. Open the visibility breakdown. Record the overall score and each available platform separately, such as ChatGPT, AI Overview, AI Mode or Gemini. Do not assume a platform exists if the tool does not show it. Record Distribution by LLM and Mentions by Country. Preserve the displayed units, values and report links or screenshots. Note missing or unavailable reports as "Not available". Use zero only when the tool explicitly reports zero. How to read the metrics safely Use Semrush's current definitions (verify in Semrush). A citation count is not automatically a count of unique website pages. Keep Citations and Cited Pages separate. Do not treat a score change as proof that one page caused it. Baseline record fields Project/domain; research date; tool/account label; country; language; platform; data-update date; comparison period; visibility score; mentions; citations; cited pages; platform breakdown; country breakdown; evidence link; notes. Baseline completion check Confirm the domain is correct, all filters are visible in the evidence, and every recorded number has a label. Example numbers from the original notes must not be reused as the project's results.

Purpose: Find relevant questions where the project's current coverage can improve. Nearby tabs in the source notes: Your Performing Topics, Topic Opportunities, Cited Sources, Source Opportunities and Cited Pages. The working path here is Topic Opportunities. Verify exact spelling and availability in Semrush. Open Topics & Sources > Topic Opportunities. Keep the same project and market filters. Record the topic, competitors mentioned, AI volume and intent exactly as displayed. Treat volume as the tool's estimate, not a promise of visits. Open a relevant topic and inspect its prompts. For each useful prompt, open View full response. Record the exact prompt, country, platform, last-update date, brands mentioned, whether the project is mentioned and whether its domain is cited. Write a short summary of the answer's questions, subtopics and missing details. Keep an evidence link or permitted private reference. Do not paste the full answer into a publishable draft. Collect the cited website URLs. Open each useful source and check that it actually supports the proposed claim. Skip social-media sources for this workflow. A search homepage alone is not evidence for a factual claim. Check the project's existing pages. Decide whether to improve an existing page, combine overlapping ideas or propose a genuinely new page. Prepare an original content brief using section 5. Prioritize relevance, user value and evidence quality. Record every opportunity and process the full list. As an added quality safeguard, flag irrelevant or duplicate prompts for review rather than blindly creating separate pages for them. Worked example Prompt: "How do I make a weekly cleaning schedule?" Research notes: Identify useful subtopics such as available time, room frequency and a sample routine. Check reliable website sources and the project's existing cleaning guide. Original brief: A realistic weekly plan for small homes, with a new worked example and editable checklist. Do not reproduce a competitor's schedule, prose or design. Stop or escalate when The prompt is outside the site's purpose, the evidence cannot be checked, the topic duplicates an existing page, or the content needs expertise the project cannot supply. Record the reason and continue with independent, suitable topics.

Purpose: Find relevant questions where selected competitors appear but the project does not. Open Competitor Research. Select the agreed country and All platforms if available. Record the selected filters. Enter the project domain under You. Add up to four relevant competitor domains. If competitors are not already agreed, propose them with reasons instead of treating any ranking site as an approved competitor. Record the displayed visibility score for each domain, the comparison period and data-update date. Do not mix this all-platform comparison with a single-platform baseline. Open Topics & Prompts, choose the Prompts view and then Missing from All / Missing / Shared / Unique. If the interface differs, locate the equivalent report and record the difference. For each relevant missing prompt, open the full response. Record the prompt, platform, country, update date, mentioned brands, citation status and website source URLs. Use the same evidence checks as Method A. Summarize coverage; do not copy the response or competitor wording. Skip Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and other social-platform sources in this workflow. Deduplicate against Method A and existing site pages. Assign a decision: improve existing page, propose new page, merge with another topic, or reject with a reason. Send the selected opportunities and briefs for review before any publishing action. Decision example If competitors appear for "weekly cleaning schedule for a small apartment" and the project already has a general cleaning guide, first check whether a useful apartment section belongs there. A new page is justified only when it serves a distinct need with enough original value. One row per opportunity ID; method; topic; exact prompt; intent; country; platform; tool update date; competitor domains; project mentioned/cited; website sources; existing page; proposed action; priority and reason; brief link; approval/status.

Prepare the page brief State the target reader, their question and the page's purpose. Choose an existing page to improve or propose a new page. Write an original outline. Cover useful questions found during research, but omit irrelevant or unsupported claims. There is no requirement to include every line of an AI answer. Attach checked website sources to the claims they support. Prefer primary evidence where available. Verify factual, product and health claims; seek expert review when needed. Add project-specific value: a new example, tested process, clear comparison, original checklist or first-hand evidence. Do not invent experience, results, credentials or product features. Draft the title, headings, concise answer and internal-link suggestions. Write in the site's voice. Do not copy AI answers, competitor prose, images, tables or distinctive layouts. Check factual accuracy, readability, source attribution, links, originality and overlap with existing pages. Obtain the required approval before publishing or changing a live page. After an approved publication Record the actual live URL and publication date. Arrange a review for seven days later, using the same domain, market, platform and prompt filters. A review is not complete merely because a reminder exists. At the review, check whether the tool has refreshed its data. Record mentions, citations, cited pages, visibility and the relevant prompt evidence. Separate "No change in refreshed data" from "Data has not refreshed" and "Not available". If results are unchanged, diagnose relevance, evidence, technical accessibility and content usefulness before adding more pages. Rules that must stay with this SOP No citation guarantee: The source notes' approximate 90% claim is not a verified success rate and must not be used as a forecast. Research is not permission: Account access, paid credits, publishing and sharing follow the user's actual approval. Report honestly: Do not present sample metrics as live results or a seven-day review as proof of causation. Source and revision: Reorganized from the user's original AI visibility notes. Original unchanged. This version adds explicit evidence checks, originality rules and approval gates; tool labels remain subject to live verification.

Preserve excluded results for audit. Method Notes: date, method, account label, database, filters/sorts, row/export limits, observed count, missing data, uncertainty and next decision. Never save creden

Method 1: Build the base competitor list Open Semrush > Domain Overview and enter our own domain. The source strategy starts with Worldwide for the overview. Treat that as orientation only; do not mix worldwide totals with target-country results. Verify this selector and path in the actual interface. Find Main Organic Competitors > View Details > Competitors. If that shortcut is absent, the official documented route is Organic Rankings > Competitors. Confirm our domain is still selected. Select the target-country database and let the report refresh. Record country, date and scope. The official report finds organic keyword overlap, not automatically direct commercial competitors. Export the Competitors table to CSV/Excel using the available Export control. Choose all available results within approved limits, not just the visible first page. Record actual exported count and any cap. Do not call an export complete when access returned only a subset. The Overview PDF is not a row-level CSV export. Make five descending top-10 views of the raw data using the source's labels: Com. Level, Common Keywords, SE Keywords, Traffic and Costs. Preserve each view or tag the rows by metric. These are sorting/shortlisting rules from the user's strategy, not confirmed named Semrush preset filters. Verify exact column labels in the live export. Combine the five lists and deduplicate normalized domains, retaining every discovery reason. Five top-10 lists provide at most 50 row slots and can yield far fewer than 50 unique domains. Validate business relevance before selection. The source target is 50 unique relevant base competitors; report the actual count and shortfall rather than padding with unrelated domains. If fewer than 50 qualify, mark the target unmet and ask whether to extend beyond the top 10 of each metric or use additional methods to fill the base target. Do not silently change this selection rule or invent a weighting formula. Later methods can add validated candidates without a fixed final total. Metric interpretation Com. Level uses both competitors' keyword portfolios and their common keywords; it is not simply the count of common keywords. Traffic and Costs are estimates, not actual visits, revenue or the competitor's advertising budget. Preserve labels and units and avoid equating organic strength with business fit. Method 2: Inspect our high-volume keywords Open Organic Rankings > our domain > Positions. Keep the agreed target country, device and date. Sort Volume from high to low. Select business-relevant keywords with target-country volume of 500 or more, as specified in the source strategy. Do not substitute global volume for local volume. This threshold is a project rule, not a Semrush requirement; log a shortfall instead of adding irrelevant broad searches. Open a selected keyword or the available SERP-preview icon, then SERP Analysis. The small screen icon/popup sequence comes from the source and needs live-interface verification. If absent,

Method 3: Keyword Gap Open Keyword Gap. Put our domain in the first You field and add up to four already known competitors. Select the agreed regional database, device/date where supported, and Organic keyword type. Select Compare. Inspect Missing, Weak and Untapped for relevant opportunities. Save the keyword and each compared domain's position, volume and KD where available. Preserve the raw CSV/Excel export and filters. Record counts only if the report supplies them or a documented calculation supports them. Look for repeated relevant keyword coverage by the compared domains. Open their sites to verify actual business fit before adding or confirming them in Final Competitors. Keyword Gap compares domains already entered; it does not automatically discover an unlimited new set of competitor domains. New candidates need another discovery source or a verified SERP lookup before being compared. Link each final domain to its supporting keywords, gap type and source report. Add a new candidate only once and append additional discovery methods to its existing record. Correct gap definitions Shared: every entered site ranks. Missing: all compared competitors rank, but You does not. Weak: You ranks lower than all compared competitors. Strong: You ranks higher than all compared competitors. Untapped: You does not rank and at least one competitor does. Unique: You ranks and none of the compared competitors do. These are relative to the selected You domain and filters, not generic labels for any single competitor. Method 4: Position Tracking Competitors Discovery With approval, open an existing correct project or set up Position Tracking for our website. Confirm country, local area, device and selected target keywords before using campaign capacity. Record configuration and collection status. Open Competitors Discovery in the Position Tracking dashboard. Review domains with repeated visibility across the tracked keyword set. A new campaign may not have usable data immediately; report pending collection, not a fabricated result. Open candidate websites and validate relevance. Record domain, relevant shared tracked keywords, Visibility %, estimated traffic and keyword positions where displayed. Save location/device/date and add Position Tracking as the discovery method. Interpret this as competition for the chosen keyword set and location, not the whole market. Do not compare its visibility percentage directly with Part A's AI visibility score or a different tracking configuration.

Method 5: Manual Google organic results Prepare searches for the site's actual products/services. Prioritize relevant commercial searches and the agreed volume criteria. For example, a home-storage business might inspect product-category and local-supplier searches; the source's stone/countertop searches are examples, not universal keywords. Check each query in the intended country/location context. Record search language, device, location setting/context and timestamp. If that context cannot be confirmed, label it unverified; do not claim a precise target-country ranking. Inspect the top 10 organic results. Record actual result URLs and positions, separately from ads, AI answers, local packs and other features. Note repeated domains, but do not assume repetition alone proves direct competition. Manual results can differ from a dated Semrush snapshot. Visit candidate sites and inspect product/service, audience and market fit. Apply the same social/marketplace exclusions to the final direct-business list. Preserve raw observations and reasons for exclusions. Final validation and handoff Combine all methods in a working list. Normalize domains consistently, but do not merge distinct businesses or subdomains with different roles without checking them. Keep original ranking URLs and evidence attached. Rate business relevance: High = closely matching offer, audience and target market; Medium = partial overlap needing review; Low = weak/unrelated fit. This is a working review rubric, not a Semrush score. Assign Direct, Organic or Indirect and Selected, Rejected or Review separately. A publisher may be an organic competitor without selling a competing product. A social platform/marketplace can remain in raw visibility evidence while excluded from the chosen direct-business list. Save actual counts by method, unique count, rejection/review reasons and the Method 1 target shortfall if any. Preserve every discovery source and supporting keyword. Present the shortlist for approval before using it to make project decisions or claims about a particular business. Quality check: correct own domain/country; untouched exports; five metric views; 500+volume applied to relevant local keywords; top10organic results distinguished; gap meanings correct; tracking config captured; sites manually validated; duplicates removed; no sample values passed off as live data. Verified, uncertain and source notes Official Semrush documentation checked on 18 November 2026 supports Organic Rankings Competitors and Positions reports, competition-level/common-keyword analysis, row exports subject to plan limits, Keyword Gap definitions/comparison and Position Tracking Competitors Discovery based on target keywords/location. No live Semrush session, exports, project setup, tracking changes or Google ranking research was performed for this SOP. Still verify in the actual interface: the Domain Overview card/Worldwide shortcut, exact five column names, the small preview icon/SERP popup s

t: New SEO Project — Client Onboarding & Kickoff Master Doc
x: Sep 30, 2026 · Prepared by the team · Universal SOP — koi pan website mate: ecommerce, service, local, blog.

Navo project aave etle aa doc ni ek copy banavo, uper client nu naam ane date lakho, pachhi Phase 0 thi niche sudhi order-wise follow karo. box ma kaam pura thay etle tick karo. Phase 1 (Baseline) sauthi important chhe — koi pan kaam start karta pehla bharo. Aaje website kya chhe te lock kari devu, jethi 3–6 mahina pachhi "pehla aavu hatu, have aavu chhe" batavi sakay. Har phase saathe rough time estimate aapel chhe (site size par depend kare). Badhu badhi site par lagu nathi padtu — client no type joine (ecommerce / service / local) je lagu pade te j karo. Order ni logic Pehla client + access, pachhi baseline, pachhi audit, pachhi research, pachhi strategy. Aa flow follow karso to kadi confuse nahi thao.

Goal: client, business ane goal samjva + badha access ek saathe levaa. (Actual kaam 2–4 kalak, pan access aavta 2–4 divas jaay.) 0.1 Client Basic Info Business name + website URL Industry / niche Business type: Ecommerce / Service / Local / SaaS / Blog Contact person + WhatsApp/email Decision maker kon? (changes kon approve karse) Platform/CMS: Shopify / WordPress / Wix / Custom Target area: local city / national / international Languages 0.2 Business Understanding (loko aa skip kare — pan sauthi important) Su vechay chhe / kai service? (top 3 money product/service) USP — client bija karta su alag? Ideal customer kon? (location, problem, budget) Average order value / lead value (ROI samajva mate) Seasonality? (koi mahina ma sales vadhe/ghate) [Added] Related SOP: 01 Client Ask (R&D) → 01 Business Goal, 02 Target Customer, 03 USP, 04 Customer Problem 0.3 SEO Goals (spashta ane number ma) Main goal: Leads / Sales / Traffic / Brand / Rankings — kayu? Success ni definition: dakhla tarike "6 mahina ma organic leads double" Timeline expectation Budget (content, tools, backlinks) Realistic expectation set karo — SEO 3–6 mahine result aape, overnight nahi Senior note Goal vague hoy ("traffic vadharvu") to project fail thavaano risk. Number ma convert karavo, nahi to result mapva nu koi base nahi rahe. 0.4 Competitor Info (client pase thi) Client na hisaab e 3–5 business competitors kon? Note: aa SEO competitors thi alag hoy sake — real SEO competitor Phase 3 ma SERP par thi nakki karis 0.5 Previous SEO History (chhupela problems ahi thi male) Pehla koi agency/freelancer e kaam karyu? Su karyu? Koi manual penalty ke moto traffic drop history? Pehla backlink building thayu? (spammy links no risk) Recent redesign / migration / URL change thayu? Koi Google update thi affect thayu lage chhe? [Added] Related SOP: 10 Reporting & Maintenance → 02 Traffic Drop Diagnosis; 08 Technical SEO → 07 Website Redesign & Migration SEO 0.6 Access Collection (badha ek saathe mango, delay avoid) Google Search Console (GSC) Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Google Tag Manager (jo hoy) CMS admin (WordPress / Shopify admin) Hosting / cPanel (technical fixes mate) Google Business Profile (local hoy to) Google Merchant Center (ecommerce hoy to) Social media accounts Ahrefs / Semrush (jo client pase hoy) [Added] Bing Webmaster Tools ane Microsoft Clarity (na hoy to setup karvanu note karo) [Added] Access hamesha client na account mathi user add karavi ne levo (GSC/GA4/GMC ma "Add user"), password share karavvano nahi. [Added] Related SOP: 07 Setup & Tracking → 01 GSC, 02 GA4 & GTM, 04 Clarity, 05 Bing

t: PHASE 1 — Baseline Snapshot (kaam start karta PEHLA — 1–2 kalak)
x: "Aaje website kya chhe" te lock kari devu. Date saathe screenshot lo. Aa j pachhi result batavva no proof chhe — baseline vagar tame kadi sabit nahi kari sako ke tamara kaam thi improvement thayu. Metric Aaj nu value Date Source Organic clicks (last 3 mahina) GSC → Performance Organic impressions GSC → Performance Avg CTR GSC → Performance Organic sessions (last 3 mahina) GA4 Key events / revenue GA4 Indexed pages GSC → Pages report Top 10 keyword rankings GSC / Ahrefs Referring domains Ahrefs / Semrush Domain Rating (DR / DA) Ahrefs / Moz Toxic / spam links % Semrush / Moz* Core Web Vitals status GSC / PageSpeed [Added] Same period last year (YoY clicks) GSC → Compare *Spam score / DA = third-party tool no metric chhe (Moz/Semrush), Google no official ranking factor nathi. Signal tarike joyo, gospel tarike nahi.

Order ni logic Pehla technical (foundation), pachhi on-page (page level), pachhi content (quality), pachhi links (authority). Foundation kharab hoy to uper nu badhu kaam waste jaay — etle technical first. 2.1 Technical SEO Audit (4–8 kalak, site size par) Crawl karo — Screaming Frog (free 500 URLs) ke Ahrefs Site Audit Robots.txt check XML sitemap (submit thayu chhe? clean chhe?) Indexing issues — GSC Pages report (kai pages index nathi ne kem) Canonical tags Redirects (301/302), redirect chains, loops 404 / soft 404 errors Duplicate content / duplicate URLs HTTPS + mixed content Mobile-friendly Core Web Vitals / page speed Structured data / schema Orphan pages, crawl budget (moti site mate) Pagination + filter/faceted URLs (ecommerce mate khaas) hreflang (international hoy to) [Added] GSC → Manual actions ane Security issues check [Added] Related SOP: 08 Technical SEO → 01–06 (khaas 06 Technical SEO Audit) 2.2 On-Page SEO Audit (3–6 kalak) Title tags (missing / duplicate / length / keyword) Meta descriptions H1 + heading structure URL structure Keyword placement + search intent match Image alt text Money pages par internal links [Added] Related SOP: 05 On-Page SEO folder 2.3 Content Audit (3–6 kalak) Kai pages traffic laave, kai nakami (GSC + GA4) Thin / duplicate / outdated content Keyword cannibalization (2 page same keyword par) Content gaps Decision per page: create / update / merge / prune [Added] Related SOP: 10 Reporting & Maintenance → 03 Content Refresh, Merge ya Remove 2.4 Internal Linking Audit (2–3 kalak) Money pages ne ketla internal links male chhe Orphan pages (koi link nathi male evi) Anchor text quality Hub-and-spoke structure chhe ke nai 2.5 Off-Page / Backlink Audit (2–3 kalak) Referring domains + DR Backlink quality (relevant ke spammy) Toxic/spam links — disavow ni jarurat? [Added: disavow fakt manual action ke paid/spam link history hoy to j; mota bhaag ni sites ne jarur nathi] Anchor text distribution Competitor saathe backlink gap [Added] Related SOP: 06 Off-Page SEO → 03 Backlink Submission, 07 DA PA & Backlink Health 2.6 Local SEO (jo local business — 1–2 kalak) Google Business Profile complete + verified NAP consistency (Name, Address, Phone badhe same) Reviews count + rating Local citations Location pages [Added] Related SOP: 06 Off-Page SEO → 04 Local SEO & Listings, 05 Global Business Submission 2.7 Ecommerce Extra (jo ecommerce) Merchant Center errors Product schema + review schema Out-of-stock / discontinued product handling Category vs product page structure [Added] Related SOP: 09 Ecommerce SEO folder 2.8 Social + AI Search Quick Check (~30 min) Social profiles active + site saathe linked Brand ChatGPT / Perplexity / Google AI Overview ma dekhaay chhe? (baseline note) Total audit time: nani site 1–2 divas, medium 3–5 divas, moti site 1–2 week.

3.1 Keyword Research (4–8 kalak) Seed keywords (business samji ne) Expand: GSC queries, Google Keyword Planner, Ahrefs/Semrush, autocomplete + People Also Ask Intent classify: informational / commercial / transactional / navigational Volume + difficulty + priority nakki karo Keyword clustering (related keywords na groups) Keyword mapping (kayu keyword kai page par jase) [Added] Related SOP: 03 Strategy → 06 Semrush Keyword to Content SOP; 05 On-Page SEO → 10 Keyword Mapping 3.2 Competitor SEO Analysis (3–5 kalak) Real SEO competitor nakki karo — SERP ma actually kon rank thaay (business competitor thi alag hoy sake) Temna top keywords + rankings Temnu content (kai topics par, keva depth ma) Temna backlinks (kya thi male chhe) Content gap: te rank thaay ne client nathi thato — te opportunities note karo Order kem aavo? Keyword research PEHLA, competitor analysis PACHHI. Karan: competitor analysis thi tamari keyword list ma nava keywords add thaay chhe ane gaps male chhe — etle pehla potanu base banavo, pachhi competitor thi enrich karo. [Added] Related SOP: 02 Domain Research → 02 Competitor Pool Analysis; 03 Strategy → 03 Competitor Gap + Keyword Gap

Money pages nakki karo (business value sauthi vadhu je pages par) Priority list — Impact × Effort framework: High impact + Low effort = pehla karo Technical fixes priority order Content plan — pillar pages + topic clusters + monthly calendar Internal linking plan (money pages ne links kya thi male) Off-page plan (quality > quantity) Nava content nu sitemap/list Timeline + milestones (Month 1, 2, 3…) Reporting setup — Looker Studio dashboard + monthly report cadence [Added] Related SOP: 02 Domain Research → 05 6 Month Planning; 03 Strategy → 01 Quick Win, 05 Content Calendar; 10 Reporting → 04 Maintenance Routine; 11 Client Reporting → 06 Monthly Client Report Format Client ne aa vaakya kaho "Pehlo mahino = audit + strategy. Actual kaam Month 2 thi start, ane result Month 3–6 thi visible thavaanu shru thase." — aa expectation set karvathi client patience rakhe chhe.

t: Time Estimate Summary (rough — site size par depend)
x: Site size: nani = 100 thi ochha pages, medium = 100–1000 pages, moti = 1000+ pages. Phase Nani site Medium site Moti site Phase 0 — onboarding + access 2–3 din 2–3 din 3–5 din Phase 1 — baseline 1 kalak 1–2 kalak 2–3 kalak Phase 2 — full audit 1–2 din 3–5 din 1–2 week Phase 3 — research 1 din 2 din 3–4 din Phase 4 — strategy half day 1 din 2 din Client ne bill/promise aa rite karo: "First 30 days = complete audit + keyword research + strategy roadmap deliver." Actual on-page/technical/content execution Month 2 thi shru.

t: Senior Reminders (har project e yaad rakho)
x: Baseline vagar result batavi nahi shakay — te sauthi pehla, kaam start karta pehla bharo. Access delay = project delay. Badha access Day 1 e ek saathe mango. Audit no order (technical → on-page → content → links) foundation-first logic chhe — na todo. Keyword research pehla, competitor analysis pachhi — competitor thi list enrich thaay. "Spam score", "DA/DR" jeva third-party metrics signal chhe, Google no ranking factor nathi — client ne evu na kaho ke aa Google no factor chhe. Har phase ma "why" client ne samjavo — te trust vadhe ane retention thaay. Goal number ma hova joiye, nahi to result mapva nu base nahi rahe. Business goal samajvu — 4 steps 1 ▶ Ask the client what they want Sales, leads or branding? One main answer, not 'everything'. 2 ⚲ Ask who buys and how the money comes B2B or B2C? Which product or service earns the most? 3 ▤ Put a number on success Example: 100 leads a month in 6 months. A goal without a number is a wish. 4 ✓ Write the goal in one sentence Every keyword, page and design decision must serve this one sentence.
Client Ask (R&D) no pehlo point. Koi pan website par kaam chalu karta pehla client no main goal clear hovo joiye - bija badha decisions (keywords, design, content) aa goal par j depend kare chhe.
Goal vagar SEO karo to traffic aave pan business ne faydo na thay. Example: client ne leads joiye ane tame blog traffic vadharo - traffic aavyu, inquiry nahi. Etle pehla goal, pachhi strategy.

Main goal su chhe? Sales (ecommerce), Leads/inquiries (service), ya Branding/awareness? Business model su chhe? B2B (business ne vechay) ke B2C (direct customer ne)? Revenue kya thi aave chhe? Kaya product/service thi sauthi vadhare kamai thay chhe? 6-12 mahina ma su achieve karvu chhe? Number ma - da. 100 leads/month, 2x sales. Atyare marketing kya thi chale chhe? Instagram, ads, referral, offline? Success kevi rite mapse? Calls, form fills, orders, store visits?
Main goal ek vakya ma lakhelu chhe B2B ke B2C clear chhe Success na numbers fix chhe Goal na adhare j aagal nu planning thay chhe

Client bole "badhu j joiye" to priority puchho: "Jo next 3 mahina ma fakt ek j vastu improve thay, te kayi?" - te j real goal chhe. Target customer & location — 3 steps 1 ☺ Draw your customer Age, job, what they type into Google, which problem they want solved. 2 ⚲ Pick your area Local (one city), India-level or international — keywords and content change with each. 3 ✓ Collect their exact search words One clear persona + decided location + real customer search words. Then move on.
Customer kon chhe ane kya chhe - be vastu clear hoy to j sacha keywords, content ane design bane. Generic website badha mate, pan sales targeted website thi j aave.

Kon chhe? Umar group, gender, job, aavak nu level. Online shu search kare chhe? Customer Google ma su lakhe te exact words note karo. Temni samasya (problem) su chhe? Je solution mate te search kare chhe. Kya decision le chhe? Mobile par ke laptop? WhatsApp ke email?

Local dhando (salon, repair, classes): city + area keywords, Google Business Profile jaruri chhe. India-level (India ecom/services): India-first keywords, Hindi/Gujarati/English mix content kaam kare chhe. International (US/UK clients): English content, tya ni spelling (color vs colour), tya na competitors check karo.

Surat ni bakery: target = Surat na 20-45 varas na loko, birthday/eggless cake search karta. Keywords: "eggless cake surat", "birthday cake delivery surat". USA client nu software: target = US small business owners, keywords in English, competitor US-based.

1 clear customer persona lakhyo chhe Location: local / India / international decide karel chhe Customer na exact search words collect karela chhe USP shodho — 4 steps 1 ⚲ Open the top 5 competitors' websites Note the main claim on each homepage. 2 ⌕ Find what the client offers that others don't Free delivery, warranty, 10 years of experience — anything competitors can't say. 3 ★ Ask the client directly Why do customers pick you? Check reviews for the same pattern. 4 ✎ Put the USP on the homepage H1, title and meta description. Never 'Welcome to our website'.

USP etle Unique Selling Point - tamara client ma aevu su chhe je competitor ma nathi? USP clear hoy to title, content ane ads badha sharp bane. USP na hoy to website "beeja jevi j" lage ane Google pan ene special rank nahi aape.

Top 5 competitors ni website kholo ane temna homepage na main claims note karo. Su offer kare chhe je bija nahi karta? Free delivery, same-day service, 10 varas experience, lowest price, handmade, warranty? Customers sauthi vadhare su vakhan kare chhe? Reviews vanchi ne pattern shodho. Client ne seedho puchho: "Customer tamne j kema pasand kare chhe?"
Homepage na H1 ane title ma Meta description ma (CTR vadharva) Product/service pages na first paragraph ma Schema ma (Offer, priceRange)

Bija badha jewellers "best designs" lakhe chhe. Jo client 100% BIS hallmark ane lifetime exchange aape chhe - te j USP chhe. Homepage par "BIS Hallmark Gold | Lifetime Exchange" bolu joiye, "Welcome to our website" nahi.

1 main USP + 2 supporting USP lakhela chhe USP homepage na H1/title ma dekhay chhe USP competitor na claims thi different chhe (copy nathi) Customer problem → solution — 4 steps 1 ⌕ Hunt for complaints Reviews (client's and competitors'), People Also Ask, Reddit, YouTube comments. 2 ☰ List the top 10 problems Real questions customers actually ask, in their own words. 3 ➜ Match each problem to an answer Problem becomes a blog topic or FAQ; the solution becomes page content. 4 ✓ Add the real questions to the FAQ Problem keywords are long-tail — easy to rank, great for AEO/GEO.
Customer koi product nahi, potani problem nu solution search kare chhe. Jo website problem first address kare ane pachhi solution aape, to Google ma pan rank saru male ane conversion pan.

Customer reviews vanchho - client na ane competitor na be. Loko su complain kare chhe? Google "People Also Ask" ma keyword lakhine juvo - te real problems chhe. Quora/Reddit/YouTube comments ma niche na prashno juvo. Client ne puchho: "Customer phone par sauthi vadhare su puche chhe?"

Har problem mate ek answer: Problem = blog topic / FAQ question Solution = service/product page content Example: "cake delivery late thay chhe" problem → "Same-day cake delivery in Surat - order before 4 PM" page
FAQ section (AEO/GEO mate pan best) Blog topics - problem keywords long-tail hoy, rank karva easy Service page headings ma customer nu j word vapru

Top 10 customer problems ni list chhe Har problem nu solution page/blog ma mapped chhe FAQ ma real customer questions add karela chhe 🚂 SOP Train: Navi route: coach 1/11 . Next coach: Phase 2 — Domain & Research → Juni route: coach 1/11 . Next coach: Phase 2 — Fix Tracking → Full train map → ← Back to the SOP Library Folder 01 · SOP Library window.SOP_BASE = "../../";
Tamara top competitors juvo etle shortcut: te loko shu rank kare chhe, su lakhe chhe, kya thi backlinks le chhe - badhu free ma roadmap male.

Top 3-5 competitors shodho: main keyword Google ma search karo - first page par je consistency sathe dekhay te j real competitors. Temna top pages note karo: kaya pages sauthi vadhare traffic lave chhe (Ubersuggest/Semrush free trial). Temna keywords juvo: kaya keywords par rank kare chhe je tamara pase nathi - te gap list chhe. Content style juvo: ketlu lamba articles, images, videos, FAQ structure, schema. Backlink sources note karo: kya sites temne link kare chhe - je relevant sites (directories, associations, PR, suppliers) tamne pan naturally link aapi shake te target list ma lo; paid/spam placements skip.
Je temna ma chhe pan tamara ma nathi (features, pages, topics) Temni weakness (slow site, old content, no FAQ) - tya jeeto Temna best content thi 10x better content banavvo

3-5 competitors ni list + notes chhe Keyword gap list banavi chhe Temna 3 strengths ane 3 weaknesses lakhela chhe Target country selection — 4 steps 1 ▶ List where your buyers actually live Real customers, not wishes. 2 ⚖ Compare the options Market size, language, competition, buying power. 3 ⚲ Pick one main country first Win one market, then expand. 4 ✓ Match keywords and content to it Their spelling, their words, their competitors.
Kaya country ne target karvu te pehla decide karo - keywords, content language, currency, examples badhu aena par depend kare chhe.

Customer kya chhe? (Client Ask na point 2 juvo) Kaya country ma competition ocho ane budget fit? India ma CPC ochu, US ma high - pan US customers nu ticket size motu. Product/service shipping ke service possible chhe? Physical product ma delivery area j check karo. Payment ane language ready? US target to USD, card payments, English content.

Local: city name keywords + Google Business Profile + local listings India: India-first keywords, pricing INR ma, Indian examples ane payment options International: hreflang (jo multiple countries), country-specific domain ke subfolder (/us/), tya na competitors benchmark
Priyank nu rule Wibestone mate: "First priority India, then US and UK". Aetle keywords India volume pramane, pachhi US/UK pages alag optimize.

Primary country fix chhe (1st priority) Secondary countries listed chhe Content language/currency country pramane set chhe Quick win finding — 4 steps 1 ▤ Open Search Console, sort by impressions Find pages Google already shows to people. 2 ⌕ Spot pages ranking 4 to 20 Almost on page 1 — small push needed, not a rebuild. 3 ↑ Apply small fixes Better title, fresher content, a few internal links. 4 ✓ Do high-impact, low-effort first Use the priority formula in the doc, not gut feeling.
Quick win etle aevi opportunities je ocha effort ma jaldi result aape. Navi site par 3-6 mahina lage, pan quick wins 2-4 week ma movement batave.

Position 5-20 vala pages: Search Console ma juvo kaya keywords par page 5-20 position par chhe - title, description, content thodu improve karo ne top 5 ma aavi shake. Low KD + sara volume keywords: je competitors e miss karela. People Also Ask na questions: FAQ add karo ne featured snippet male. Zero-click sudhara: title/description CTR improve karo - same position par pan traffic vadhare. Orphan ane thin pages fix karo: je pages ne koi link nathi, tene link aapo.
Quick win = (saru potential traffic) x (ochu effort). Pehla te karo je 1 kalak ma thay ane 30 divas ma result batave.

Search Console mathi top 10 opportunity pages listed 5 low-KD keywords pasand karela Dar quick win mate owner ane deadline fix chhe 6 month planning — 3 phases 1 ▤ Months 1-2: fix the base Technical setup, tracking, audit fixes. 2 ✎ Months 3-4: content push On-page work and new content on priority pages. 3 ↗ Months 5-6: grow Off-page, refresh old content, measure everything monthly.
SEO marathon chhe, sprint nahi. 6 mahina nu realistic plan banavvo etle client pan wait kare ane kaam pan systematic chale.

Month 1: Full audit (on-page, technical, content) karo, quick wins implement karo, GSC/GA4 setup verify karo. Month 2: On-page fixes (title, meta, headings, internal links) karo, must-have pages complete karo. Month 3: Content engine chalu - week ma 2-4 blogs, keyword gap cover karva. Month 4: Off-page chalu - backlinks, Reddit/Quora, social signals. Month 5: Content update (old pages refresh), schema ane AEO/GEO optimization. Month 6: Review su work karyu, su nahi. Double down on working pages, strategy adjust.
Dar mahine: impressions, clicks, position (GSC), users (GA4), leads/sales note karo Apeksha: Mahina 1-2 ma flat, Mahina 3-4 ma movement, Mahina 5-6 ma visible growth

6 mahina nu written plan chhe Monthly metrics track thay chhe Client ne timeline pehle divas e j samjavi chhe Domain name finding — 4 steps 1 ★ Follow the 3 rules Short, brandable, easy to say and spell. 2 ⌕ Check it is free .com first. No trademark trouble. 3 ⚿ Check its past No spam history — an old bad reputation follows the name. 4 ✓ Register it Only after all checks pass.
Saru domain name = brand nu foundation. Lamba term ma SEO, branding ane marketing badha ma faydo kare.

Keyword pramane: main keyword domain ma hoy to relevance signal male (da. "suratcakes.in"). Pan exact-match domain par over-optimize nahi - brand + keyword mix best. Country pramane: India target to .in, global to .com. Local trust mate country domain better rank kare te country ma. Yaad rakhva easy: 2-3 words max, spelling easy, phone par bolva ma samjay aevu, no hyphens/numbers jo avoid thay to.

Existing site hoy to pehla GSC juo — e real data chhe. Niche na free tools tyare vaparo jyare Semrush na hoy ke quick idea joiye.

Keyword etle e exact shabd ke phrase je loko Google ma type kare chhe. Tamara page nu content e search sathe match thay, to Google e page ne result ma batave chhe. Ek example: koi Google ma type kare "ghar par easy science experiment" — aakhu e vakya j keyword chhe, fakt "science" nahi. Ek vaat yaad rakho: keyword e fakt shabd nathi, e user ni need chhe. Same shabd pachhal alag-alag need hoi shake — "laptop" search karnar koi kharidva mange chhe, koi fakt compare karva mange chhe. Etle shabd ni sathe e need (search intent) pan jovi padshe.

Keyword nakki kare chhe ke page kona mate lakhayu chhe. Keyword focus vagar page lakho to page kai search mate chhe e clear nathi rahetu — Google ane users banne mate. Sacha loko aave chhe — je user ne kharekhar tamari service ke content joiye chhe e j aave, etle bounce ochho ane conversion vadhu. Free traffic — ek vaar rank thay pachhi ad kharcha vagar mahino-mahino traffic aave. Content ne disha male — keyword khabar hoy to shu lakhvu, ketlu lakhvu, kaya subtopic cover karva e badhu clear thai jay. Page-page vachche takrav na thay — dar page ne potano alag keyword aapo to be page ek-bija sathe competition nathi karta.

Be rite type padta hoy chhe — lambai pramane ane intent (user ni need) pramane. Nava page mate banne jova padshe. Lambai pramane Type Lambai Example Kyare vaparvu Head / short-tail 1–2 shabd science experiment Home page ke moti category page — competition bahu vadhare Body 2–3 shabd science experiment kit Category ke service page Long-tail 3+ shabd easy science experiments at home for kids Blog post ane navi site mate best — rank karvu sahelu Intent pramane Intent User shu mange chhe Example search Kevu page joiye Informational Janvu chhe, shikhvu chhe how to do science experiment Blog, guide, how-to Commercial Compare karvu chhe, decide karvu chhe best science kit for kids Comparison, review, listicle Transactional Kharidvu ke inquiry karvi chhe buy science kit online Product ke service page Navigational Koi khaas brand ke page shodhvu chhe amazon science kit Brand nu potanu page Intent match na thay to page game tetlu saru hoy, rank nahi thay. Transactional keyword par blog mukso to Google e blog ne upar nahi lave.

t: 4. Nava page mate keyword kevi rite shodhvu (7 steps)
x: Aa 7 step dar vakhte same order ma follow karo — koi pan nava page mate kaam aavshe. Aakhi process ma 30–45 minute thay chhe. Page nu kaam nakki karo (2 min): Ek line ma lakho — aa page kona mate chhe ane page par aavine user shu karshe (vanchshe / inquiry karshe / kharidshe). Aa line j intent nakki karshe. Seed keyword ni list banavo (5 min): Tool kholya vagar, page na topic par 5–10 shabd pote lakho — jem customer bolta hoy tem. Client ni website, juni inquiries, sales team na shabdo ane competitor na menu mathi pan seed male. Google parthi j expand karo (5 min): Free ane sauthi sacho source. Seed type karo ane autocomplete na suggestions note karo; result page niche "Related searches" juo; "People Also Ask" box na questions note karo — e FAQ ane H2 mate seedha kaam lage. Tool ma nakhi ne list moti karo (10 min): Seed ne Semrush Keyword Magic Tool (target country database) ma nakho ane volume, KD ane variations kadho. 30–50 keyword ni ek list banavo. Competitor pasethi shikho (5 min): Je 3 site aa topic par top ma rank kare chhe, temna URL Semrush Organic Research ma nakho. Temne kaya keyword par traffic male chhe e juo ane je tamari list ma nathi e umero. Temna title ane H1 pan juo — e temnu primary keyword j hoy chhe. (Content copy nahi — fakt keyword ideas.) Google ma search kari ne SERP check karo (5 min): Aa step mota bhaag na loko chhodi de chhe. Top 10 ma kaya type na page chhe? Badha blog hoy ane tame product page banavta ho to match nathi thatu. Top ma fakt moti authority sites (Amazon, Wikipedia, Government) hoy to e keyword hamna chhodo. Nana ke nava domain dekhay to e keyword tamara mate jitay evu chhe. Ek primary keyword final karo (3 min): Niche na 5 check lagu karo ane ek keyword primary tarike nakki karo. Baki na 3–5 keyword secondary tarike rakho — e H2 ane body ma vaprashe. Short ma Topic → Seed → Google suggestions → Tool → Competitor → SERP check → Final pick.

Google na potana free sources (login vagar) Source Kya male Shu male Autocomplete Search box ma type karta Loko kharekhar je type kare chhe e phrases People Also Ask Result page ni vachche Questions — FAQ ane H2 mate taiyar Related searches Result page na sauthi niche Aaspaas na topics ane variations Google Trends trends.google.com Topic vadhi rahyo chhe ke ghati rahyo, ane kaya state/season ma vadhu Search Console Tamari potani site nu data Kaya keyword par site pehla thi impressions lai rahi chhe — nava page na best idea ahiya thi male Keyword tools Tool Free ke paid Sauthi saru shu mate Semrush (team standard) Paid (limited free) Volume, KD, competitor na keyword — aakhu kaam ek j jagyae Google Keyword Planner Free (Ads account joiye) Volume ni range ane commercial keywords Ahrefs Paid Keyword difficulty ane backlink data Ubersuggest Free limit sathe Nana project ane quick ideas AnswerThePublic Free limit sathe Question-type long-tail keywords Keyword Surfer (Chrome) Free Google result page par j volume dekhay Google Search Console Free Potani site na real keyword — estimate nahi, actual data Ek tool na number bija tool sathe match nahi thay — badha estimate j chhe. Etle exact number pachhal na padvu; range ane comparison jovu.

t: 6. Final karta pehla aa 5 check karo
x: Keyword par final tick tyare j lagavo jyare panche ma "haa" aave. Check Shu jovu Green signal Search volume Mahine ketla search Nani/navi site: 50–500. Established site: 500+ Keyword difficulty (KD) Tool ma 0–100 no score Navi site: 0–30. Authority vadhi hoy: 40 sudhi Intent match Top 10 ma je type na page chhe e tamara page jevu chhe? Haa — to j aagal vadho SERP ma jagya chhe? Top 10 ma nana domain, forum ke blog dekhay chhe? Haa. Badhu Amazon/Wikipedia hoy to na Business value Aa keyword thi aavnar user client mate kaam no chhe? Haa — inquiry ke sale sudhi lai jay evo Dhyan rakho: 10,000 volume valu keyword je rank j nahi thay, e 200 volume vala keyword karta nakamu chhe je 1st page par aavi jay. Volume karta jitay evu hovu vadhu important chhe. Ghani vaar 0 volume batavtu keyword pan kaam nu hoy chhe — khaas kari ne local ane B2B ma, jya tool pase data ocho hoy chhe. Jo keyword logical hoy ane competitor e vaparyu hoy, to te lai shakay.

Dar page ne ek j primary keyword aapo, ane e keyword biji koi page ne na aapo. Sathe 3–5 secondary keyword rakho je same intent na hoy — e H2 ma ane body ma naturally aavshe. Role Keyword Kya vaprashe Primary easy science experiments at home Title, URL, H1, pehlo paragraph Secondary science experiments for kids at home Ek H2 ane body Secondary simple science activities with household items Biju H2 Secondary how to do science experiment at home FAQ ma question tarike Keyword cannibalization thi bachvu Be page same keyword ane same intent par target kare to Google vaaramvar page badle (fluctuation) ane banne weak rahi shake. Aa thi bachva mate: Ek Master Keyword Map sheet rakho (niche section 8 nu standard format). Nava page nu keyword nakki karta pehla e sheet ma search kari lo ke e keyword pehla thi vaparelu chhe ke nahi. Pehla thi hoy to navu page banavvana badle e junu page j update karvu vadhu saru chhe. Quick rit: Google ma site:tamarisite.com "keyword" search karo — ketla page e keyword par chhe e dekhai jashe. GSC → Query → Pages tab pan juo.

Jagya Kevi rite mukvu Dhyan Title tag Keyword sharuat ma, 50–60 character Title ma keyword hovu sauthi vadhu asar kare chhe URL slug Short, hyphen sathe: /easy-science-experiments-home Stop words (a, the, for) kadhi nakho H1 Page par ek j H1, ema primary keyword Title ane H1 thoda alag hoy to chale Pehla 100 shabd Sharuat na paragraph ma ek vaar Parane na ghusado H2 / H3 Secondary keywords ane PAA na questions Dar heading ma keyword hovu jaruri nathi Image alt text Image ma kharekhar shu chhe e lakho Alt accessibility mate chhe, keyword box nathi Meta description 150–160 character, keyword sathe Ranking par direct asar nathi, pan click vadhare chhe Internal links Bija page thi aa page sudhi keyword vala anchor text sathe 2–3 relevant links Density nu koi fix percentage nathi. 1,000 shabd na page ma primary keyword 3–5 vaar aave e puratu chhe — baki synonyms ane related shabdo vaparo.

Karvu Long-tail thi sharuat karo, pachhi authority vadhe tem short keyword taraf jao. SERP dar vakhte pote juo — tool no number khoto hoi shake, SERP nahi. Question-type keyword alag list ma rakho, e FAQ ane featured snippet mate kaam aave. Local business hoy to shaher nu naam umero: "seo services in surat". Dar 3–6 mahine Search Console ma juo ke page kaya keyword par aavi rahyu chhe — nava idea tyathi male. Na karvu Keyword stuffing — ek j shabd vaar-vaar ghusadvo. Google e pakde chhe ane ranking ghate chhe. Ek page par 5–6 alag-alag intent na keyword target karva. Fakt volume joine keyword pasand karvo, difficulty ane SERP joya vagar. Exact match pachhal padvu — grammar todi ne lakhvani jarur nathi, natural vakya chalshe. Competitor je keyword par chhe e badha j copy karva — temni authority tamara karta alag chhe. Keyword nakki karya vagar content lakhi nakhvu ane pachhi keyword fit karvano prayas karvo.

t: Quick Win - Top 4-10 Pages nu Title & Description
x: Je pages Google ma position 4-10 par chhe (first page, pan top 3 ma nathi) tenu title ane meta description improve karo. Aa sauthi fast ROI valo SEO move chhe: content change karva jevu effort nahi, pan CTR ane ranking banne improve thay.

Search Console kholo → Performance → Pages. Position 4-10 vala pages filter karo. Impressions vadhare, CTR ocho vala pages pehla select karo - title/description no j problem chhe. Title rewrite karo: primary keyword first, number/power word add karo (da. "2026", "Best", "Guide", "Free"), 50-60 characters. Description rewrite karo: benefit CTA + keyword, 150-160 characters. Question format CTR vadharave (da. "Looking for X?"). 2-4 week wait karo ane CTR/position compare karo.

[Number] [Keyword] + [Benefit] → "7 Eggless Cake Designs je Surat ma Famous chhe" [Keyword] [Year] + [Brand] → "SEO SOP 2026 | RadhaVision" How to + [Keyword] + [Result] → "How to Choose Domain Name je Rank kare"

Top 4-10 position vala pages identify karya (GSC) Title: keyword pehla, 50-60 chars, power word Description: faydo + CTA, 150-160 chars Changes na dates noted (before/after compare karva) Content improvement (pages 10-20) — 3 steps 1 ▤ Pick pages ranking 10 to 20 Good enough to show up, not good enough to win yet. 2 ✎ Make the content genuinely better More depth, FAQs, fresh info — follow the check list in the doc. 3 ✓ Republish and track Log the date; judge after a few weeks.
Position 10-20 (second page) vala pages ne top 10 ma lavva mate title patse nahi content j improve karvu padshe. Second page = Google page ne relevant mane chhe pan enough quality/depth nathi.

GSC ma position 10-20 vala pages shodho. Top 3 competitor pages vanchho same keyword mate - temna ma su chhe je tamara ma nathi? Content depth vadharo: missing subtopics add karo ane navu value (data, examples, experience) - word count target nahi. Structure improve karo: H2/H3 proper hierarchy, FAQ section add karo, internal links add karo (3-5). Freshness signal: date update, new examples, latest data add karo. Media add karo: images, screenshots, tables - text-only pages harai jay chhe.

Page target keyword nu intent satisfy kare chhe? (Informational query par product page hoy to flip karo) Core Web Vitals pass chhe? (On-Page point 4 juvo) Page ne internal links male chhe? Na hoy to 2-3 relevant internal links aapo; trusted sources ne 1-2 outbound citations; backlinks mate Off-Page SOP juo

10-20 position vala pages ni list taiyar Competitor comparison complete (shu missing chhe te list karo) Depth structure + freshness improves karela 1 month ma position re-check scheduled Competitor + keyword gap — 4 steps 1 ⚲ Line up your keywords against competitors' Side by side, same market. 2 ⌕ Find keywords they rank for and you don't Each gap is a page idea. 3 ☰ No tool? Use the manual method The doc shows a tool-free way too. 4 ✎ Turn gaps into a page list In the output format given, ready for the calendar.
Competitors je keywords par rank kare chhe ane tame nahi - te list j tamari next 3-6 mahina ni content strategy chhe. Gap analysis = ready-made roadmap.

Tool select karo: Semrush (Keyword Gap tool), Ahrefs (Content Gap), ke free option - Ubersuggest + manual Google search. Tamaru domain vs 3-4 competitors enter karo. Filter: competitors top 20 ma, tame 50+ ke absent - te keywords export karo. Cluster karo: similar keywords ne group karo - ek group = ek page/blog (keyword cannibalization avoid karva). Priority set karo: Volume x (1/KD) x business relevance - je highest te pehla.

Main keyword search karo, competitor na top pages open karo, temna H2/H3 topics note karo - tame cover karel nathi te gap chhe Google "People Also Ask" ane "Related Searches" manually note karo (ke Semrush Questions / AlsoAsked jeva tools) - automated scraping nahi

[v1.1 navu] 2A. Existing site hoy to pehla GSC (free ane sauthi accurate) GSC → Performance → Search results → last 3 months → Queries tab. Filter: Position 8 thi 30 + impressions vadhare. Aa keywords par Google tamari site ne already relevant maane chhe — sauthi jaldi result aa j aape. Query par click → Pages tab: kayo page rank thay chhe te note karo (Step 5 ma Update decision mate). Aa list 'GSC Opportunities' tab ma muko. Semrush data sathe match karo — GSC real chhe, Semrush estimate. 2B. Keyword Overview (Semrush) Semrush → Keyword Overview → seed keyword nakho (example: meal planner template) → database = target country (example: US). Jovu: Volume (target country nu), KD%, Intent, CPC, SERP features (images, PAA, AI Overview, shopping). Niche 'Questions' list joi lo — aa FAQ / H2 ideas mate kaam aavse. Export kari lo. 2C. Keyword Magic Tool (Keyword ideas) 'Keyword ideas' → View all → Keyword Magic Tool khulse. Database = target country. Broad match tab rakho (sauthi vadhare ideas). Example result: 748 keywords, total volume 18,720, average KD 26%. Filters lagavo: Volume ≥ 50 (niche ma 20 pan chale), KD% ≤ tamari site ni capacity (navi/low authority site mate 0-30 thi sharu karo), Language = English. Left side na groups (example: printable, free, weekly, family, google sheets) joi lo — aa j pachhi cluster ideas bane chhe. Export → sheet ma 'Raw Keywords' tab ma paste karo. Senior tip KD ni limit fix number nathi. Strong DA/backlinks vali site 40-50 KD par pan rank kari shake; navi site mate 0-25 thi start karvu safe chhe. Pehla tamari site kaya KD na keywords par already page 1 par chhe e GSC + Semrush Organic Research ma juo — e tamari 'safe KD range' chhe. [LIKELY — industry practice] [v1.1 navu] Semrush na hoy to — free alternatives • Google Search Console: existing site mate sauthi saro source (real queries). • Google Keyword Planner: volume ranges (exact number ad spend vagar nathi male), country select thay. • Google autocomplete, People Also Ask, Related searches: long-tail ane question keywords. • Google Trends: seasonality ane rising topics. • KD nu manual check: top 10 ma kon chhe juo — moti brands/marketplaces j hoy to agharu; forums, nana blogs, juna pages hoy to chance chhe. Process same rahe — fakt data sources badlay.

Original notes ma 'highest volume + lowest KD' lakhyu hatu — e sachu chhe, pan adhuru. Aa filter lagavo: Check Shu jovu Example Relevance Business ne kaam nu chhe? Je vechta nathi teno keyword kaadho Meal planner app na hoy to 'meal planner app download' kaadho Intent Keyword nu intent tamara page type sathe match thay chhe? 'buy meal planner notebook' = product/collection; 'how to meal plan' = blog Business value Aa traffic sale/lead aape? (CPC pan signal chhe — vadhu CPC = advertisers ne aa traffic thi kamai) 'free meal planner template' traffic aape, sale ochhu; 'meal planner notebook' sale nu Volume Target country volume US: 2,400 KD % Tamari safe range ma? 26% → OK Simple priority score (sheet ma column banavo): Priority = Business Value (1-3) × Intent match (1-3) × Opportunity (1-3, volume vadhu + KD ochhu = 3) Score 18-27 = pehla banavo, 8-17 = pachhi, 1-7 = skip. Aa formula andha thai ne na vaparvu — client e koi product push karvu hoy to te upar aave. [v1.1 navu] GSC ma position 8-30 vala keywords ne +1 Opportunity aapo — tya page already chhe.

t: Step 4 — Keyword Strategy Builder: Topic, Pillar, Cluster
x: Semrush → Keyword Strategy Builder → seed keyword(s) nakho → country select → 2-3 min ma SERP analyze thase. All Pages / Topics tab: dar topic ma ek pillar page + ena cluster pages dekhase. Example: Topic: printable meal planner templates — Total volume 97,590, Avg KD 32.52%. Dar topic nu naam + volume + KD sheet ma 'Topic Map' tab ma save karo. Topic par click → pillar page keyword (example: meal planner template) par click → tena related keywords + KD + volume malse. Aa pillar page na secondary keywords chhe. 'Potential SERP competitors and content references' na 10 URLs copy karo — Step 6 ma vaparvana chhe. Puro topic (pillar + clusters + keywords) ek sathe sheet format ma export kari lo — data accurate rahe. Semrush na grouping par blind trust na karvo — SERP overlap test Be keyword ek page ma jase ke alag? Google ma bane search karo (same country, incognito). Top 10 ma 3-4 ke vadhu same URLs hoy → Google ene same topic maane chhe → ek j page. Overlap 0-2 hoy → alag page. Tool khota grouping kare tyare aa test j final decision chhe. [LIKELY — widely used industry method]

t: Step 5 — Keyword mapping + existing page ni tapas
x: Rule: 1 primary keyword (ane eno group) = 1 URL. Ek keyword be page par target na thavo joie. 5A. Existing page check (cannibalization rokva) Google ma search: site:clientdomain.com meal planner GSC → Performance → Queries filter: 'meal planner' → Pages tab: kayo page already impressions le chhe? 5B. Decision table — New, Update, Merge ke Remove? Situation Decision Koi page j nathi New page banavo Page chhe, impressions aave chhe, position 8-30 Update karo (sauthi jaldi result aape) — new page nahi 2 page same intent par, beu weak Merge karo → strong page rakho, biju 301 redirect Page juno, traffic 0, backlinks 0, business kaam nu nathi Remove / noindex vicharvo (pehla backlinks + sales check) Vadhu detail: 10 Reporting & Maintenance → 03 Content Refresh, Merge ya Remove. 5C. Page type intent thi nakki thay — volume thi nahi Google na top 10 ma mostly shu chhe? Tamaru page type Product / collection pages (shops) Collection / Category page Blog / guide / list articles Blog post Free download / template pages Resource / template page (download sathe) Local businesses, map pack Service / location page + Google Business Profile Mixed (shops + blogs banne) Je type vadhare chhe te; jarur hoy to collection + supporting blog banne, ek-bija ne link 5D. Slug (URL) na rules Pillar no slug = primary keyword nu short version: /meal-planner-template/ (notes ma kahyu tem highest-volume relevant keyword — sachu, pan intent match pehla). Cluster slug = eno potano primary keyword: /printable-weekly-meal-planner/ Short, lowercase, hyphen, no dates/years (refresh vakhte URL badalvo na pade). Competitor no slug copy karvani jarur nathi — slug ranking ma nano role chhe; tamaro keyword clear hoy e j poorto chhe. [CONFIRMED that URL words are a minor factor per Google] Juna page nu slug badalvu hoy to 301 redirect farjiyat.

Original notes: 'top 5 ni jevo 70% content' ane '90% same content, 10% change'. Sudharo: top results mathi shikho ke Google shu reward kare chhe, pachhi ena karta vadhu useful page banavo. Text, structure ke wording copy na karvu. Dar top 5-10 URL mate 'SERP Analysis' tab ma aa columns bharo: Column Shu lakhvu Page type Blog / collection / tool / template download Format 10 templates ni list, step guide, comparison, video Approx length Word count range (exact match karvani jarur nathi — word count ranking factor nathi) H2 topics Kaya sub-topics cover kare chhe Common topics Je 3+ pages ma chhe → tamara page ma hova joie (must-cover) Missing / weak Je koi e saru nathi karyu → tamaro chance (information gain) Trust signals Lekhak, asli photos, reviews, original data SERP features PAA, images, video, AI Overview — tamaro format te pramane [v1.1 navu] AI Overview AI Overview dekhay chhe? Kaya sites cite thay chhe ane te pages ma shu common chhe (clear definition, direct answer, list)? Information gain ideas (ahiya thi j rank aave chhe): Potanu original template / printable / calculator (example: free downloadable meal planner PDF) Real photos, real use example, client/product no first-hand experience Comparison table, step-by-step, common mistakes je competitors e cover nathi karya Ecommerce: size guide, material info, kaya age/use mate — real buyer questions [v1.1 navu] AI Overview vala SERP mate (LIKELY / industry observation) AI Overview vala keywords par clicks ochha aavi shake (zero-click). Teva keyword par: (1) H2 pachhi pehla 2-3 line ma sidho jawab, (2) clear definitions ane lists, (3) original data/experience je AI ne cite karvo pade. Pan Google e AI Overview citation mate koi alag 'optimization' confirm nathi kari — saru SEO j base chhe. Business decision ma aa keywords nu traffic expectation ochhu rakho.

t: Ecommerce Blog SEO Workflow: Category thi Blog sudhi
x: Koi pan category / collection par sales ane organic traffic laave evo blog banavva mate 3-step process. 04 Blog Strategy no full detail version.

Step 1: Category page joi ne blog title options banavo, pachhi client pase review karavo. Step 2: Final title par website mathi j Top 5 products ane target keywords levaa. Step 3: Title, products, keywords ane 5 rules saathe final blog lakho. Why aa order? Pehla title nakki thaay to j sacha products ane keywords male. Products ane keywords nakki thaay pachhi j blog sacha internal links ane sales laave.

Category / collection page kholo: kaya products che, kaya problem solve kare che, kon kharide che (e.g. new parents) — note karo. GSC → Performance → Page filter = collection URL → Queries: aa collection par kaya informational/question queries impressions le che? Aa blog title na best ideas che. Semrush Keyword Magic Tool (target country) → collection no main keyword → Questions tab. Google PAA ane autocomplete pan juo. Search intent check: title nu keyword Google ma search karo — top results blogs/guides hova joiye. Products/collections j dekhay to e blog topic nathi (collection page j optimize karo). 5 title options lakho, dar ek sathe 1 line: kem saru che (traffic + sales + intent). Rule: title collection na products sathe naturally jodai shake. Client ne review mate mokalo. Approve thayelu title j Step 2 ma vaparo.

2A. Top 5 products Collection mathi title ne sauthi relevant 5 products pasand karo — in-stock, saru selling, ane blog na alag-alag sections ma fit thay evi. Dar product mate note karo: product name, product URL, blog ma kya section ma vaparvu. Product repeat na karvi, jarur hoy to j. Title related biji collection hoy to tena product/link pan add kari shako. Dhyan rakho: Dar product URL website par khoti ne check karo — URL kharekhar khule che ane product in-stock che. Check karya vagar koi URL blog ma na vaparo. 2B. Target keywords Primary: 1 keyword (title no main) — Semrush ma volume + KD check (06 Semrush SOP pramane). Secondary: sambandhit variations. Topic-wise: blog na sections pramane (e.g. nail / hair / daily care). Audience-intent: audience mate (e.g. new-parent keywords). AEO / GEO long-tail questions: Semrush Questions + Google PAA thi — FAQ ane H2/H3 mate.

Writer ne (ke tame pote lakhta ho to) aa brief aapo: Vigat Shu aapvu Blog title Client dwara approve thayelu final title Collection link Main collection URL — blog ma 2 vaar internal link Products Step 2 na 5 products: name + verified URL + section Keywords Step 2 na badha keyword groups Formatting Important text bold; blog ma real image na muko — fakt photo space (Rule 3) Rules (niyamo) Niche na 5 rules strictly follow karvana

Product mention rule: Paragraph ma kadi pan full product name na lakhvu (bold ke plain, kai j nahi). Tena badle short, natural, lowercase anchor text (2 thi 5 words) vaparvu, jem ke "modular baby crawl mat". Aa anchor text j clickable link hoy, sentence ni andar naturally, alag line ma nahi. Link rule: Fakt verified real product URL j vaparvo. URL na hoy to product text ma mention karo pan link na banavo. Fake ke guess URL kadi nahi. Photo space rule: Je paragraph ma product link hoy, tena tarat pachhi aa 2 lines muko, badhe same format (niche joyo). Alt text rule: Lowercase, natural spacing, "collection" ke "category" jeva words nahi. Bullet punctuation rule: Badha bullet points ma ek j punctuation, ya badhe colon (:) ya badhe dash (-). Mix nahi. Photo space format (Rule 3): Alt text: [lowercase alt text] (photo mate jagya)

t: Monthly SEO Plan — Off-Page + Blog SOP
x: Source: SEO Playbook (Guide 2). Main rule: darek mahine badhu nahi — best opportunities pehla pick karo.

1. GSC thi shuru karo GSC → Performance → Search results → Date: Last 3 months. QUERIES tab: kaya terms ne impressions/clicks/rank. PAGES tab: kaya URLs ne visibility. GSC ma shu dekhaay Shu karvu Position 5–20 + good impressions Striking distance → priority (jo intent + business value strong) High impressions + low clicks Title/meta, intent, SERP competition check (AI Overview chhe ke nahi pan juo) Clicks aave pan Top 3 nahi Content + internal links + authority support Impressions vadhe Demand vadhe → right page rank thay chhe? Same query par ghana URLs Cannibalization → navo page banavta pehla review Note: Position 5–20 ek filter chhe, rule nahi. Relevance, intent, business value, competition, quality pan juo. 2. Priority pages select karo Site moti hoy to pan mahine thoda j pages par focus. Decide by: GSC impressions/clicks · ranking 5–20 · business value · seasonality · page ready chhe? · competition realistic. Examples (site → focus): Nursery → Hydrangea collection + 2 products · Software → SEO/Web/Shopify service · Snacks → Healthy Snacks + Namkeen · Catering → Corporate + Wedding. 3. Keyword → correct page map Keyword Intent Correct page buy hydrangea plants online Commercial Collection / category how to care for hydrangeas Informational Blog / guide shopify development company Commercial Service page healthy snacks for office Informational Blog / guide Mapping sheet columns: Priority · Target URL · Primary KW · Secondary KW · Position · Impressions · Why.

4. Blog strategy (on-page) Priority page → related info queries / People Also Ask research. GSC ma related queries check karo; existing blog duplicate na thay. Topic evo je commercial page sathe naturally connect thay. People-first content → contextual internal links → GSC monitor. Formula Priority Money Page → Related Info Intent → Helpful Blog → Internal Link → Commercial Page. 5. Off-page plan Mahina na priorities + brand authority support. Backlink quantity goal NAHI. Priority URL list pehla banavo. Relevant, legit platforms; manipulation mate banela placements avoid karo. Natural anchor mix: brand / URL / partial / topical; exact-match fakt jyare naturally fit thay. Badha links homepage par nahi; deeper page tyare j jyare context support kare. Same anchor repeat / mass low-quality nahi. Record: source, target, anchor, type, date, status.

6. Monthly workflow (10 step) GSC 3 months (Queries + Pages) → opportunity list. Rankings business + seasonality → shortlist. Priority pages select → target URLs. Primary secondary keyword map. Supporting blog topics → blog plan. Contextual internal links → link map. Off-page anchor mix → off-page sheet. Execute badhu kaam track karo. Month-end: rankings, clicks, impressions compare → report. Justified priorities carry forward; navi opportunities pick → next month. 7. Month-end measurement Keyword position start vs end · priority-page clicks/impressions · CTR. Organic traffic + leads · new referring domains · kaya blogs ne impressions · shu improve thayu + next action. [Added] Same length period sathe compare karo (28 days vs previous 28 days); seasonal business mate YoY pan. 8. Quick checklist (finalize karta pehla) GSC 3 months Queries + Pages reviewed Priority pages + reason Search intent + Keyword → URL map Cannibalization checked Seasonality / business priority Supporting blogs selected Internal links planned Off-page URLs + anchor direction Baseline saved · month-end compare scheduled Related SOP: 03 Strategy → 01 Quick Win, 06 Semrush SOP, 07 Ecommerce Blog Workflow; 06 Off-Page SEO → 07 DA PA & Backlink Health; 10 Reporting → 04 Maintenance Routine; 11 Client Reporting → 06 Monthly Client Report Format. Niche badlay, process nahi. Niche-specific vaat fakta 3 chhe: keywords, competitors, target country. Baki akho flow (00 START HERE no order) universal chhe — etle j aa SOPs 100 sites par chale. Effort scale nahi thay, system scale thay. 100 sites = 100x kaam nahi — templates, master sheets, automation ane team roles thi per-site kaam 60-70% ochhu thay. Quality gate kyarey skip nahi. 100 thin sites karta 10 quality sites vadhare kamave. Google scaled content abuse policy badha sites par lagu (CONFIRMED).

t: 10 Fast Ranking Strategy — Realistic Timeline sathe (11 Nov 2026)
x: Koi pan site — navi ke juni — ne sauthi jadpi rank karavvani sachi (honest) strategy. Sources niche. Claim labels: CONFIRMED (Google official) / LIKELY (industry data).

t: 0. Pehla sach samjo — "1-2 divas ma rank" nu reality
x: CONFIRMED: Google potee kahe chhe — "No one can guarantee a #1 ranking on Google" (Google: Do you need an SEO?). Koi pan person/tool je 1-2 divas ni guarantee aape, e khotu bole chhe ke indexing ne ranking samje chhe. CONFIRMED: Google Starter Guide: "Some changes might take effect in a few hours, others could take several months. Wait a few weeks before judging." Indexing ≠ Ranking. Page Google ma index thay e kala ko ma thay shake — pan koi keyword par page 1 par aavvu e alag vaat chhe. CONFIRMED (John Mueller, Google): Navi site ne Google "unique value" samajva ma time le chhe — navi site par trust build thava do. 1-2 divas ma su shakya chhe: indexing (key pages), brand name keywords, ane ekdum low-competition long-tail je koi target j nathi kartu. Aa "fast" chhe — pan contested keyword mate nahi.

t: 1. Realistic timeline table (experience data — Google nahi)

t: 2. Speed levers — je sach ma kaam kare (priority order ma)
x: Crawl blockers kadho — noindex, robots.txt block, khotu canonical. URL Inspection thi check karo. Aa hoay to baki badhu zero. (CONFIRMED) Sitemap clean ane submitted — badha canonical URLs, saacho lastmod. (CONFIRMED) Homepage/hub thi internal link — Google je pages varrecrawl kare tya thi link — manual request karta jadpi. (CONFIRMED/LIKELY) Request Indexing — GSC URL Inspection → key pages only. Quota limited; ranking ne speed nahi aape, faqt crawl. (CONFIRMED) IndexNow on — Bing/Yandex/Seznam/Naver mate instant notify. Google IndexNow vanche j nahi (2022 ma test kari ne reject karyu). Free, ek toggle (Cloudflare/Shopify/Wix/RankMath). (CONFIRMED) Google Indexing API — faqt JobPosting ke livestream (BroadcastEvent) pages mate. General pages mate scope violation = quota revoke risk. (CONFIRMED) Server fast + error-free — slow server par Googlebot ochho crawl kare. (CONFIRMED — crawl budget docs) Position 4-20 pages improve karo — e pages already Google ni nazar ma chhe; title/CTR/content improve karvo = sauthi fast ranking gain (03 → 01, 03 → 02). Zero-KD / long-tail target karo — specific questions ("blue cotton kurti under 500"), e jaldi rank thay. Volume ochho pan jeet guaranteed nazde. (LIKELY) AI surfaces (AIO/GEO) — well-structured answer content (AEO format: 05 → 07) AI Overviews ma new sites ne pan jaldi show thay shake long-tail queries ma. (LIKELY)

Day 1-2: Technical foundation complete (07 Setup folder badhu) + sitemap + IndexNow on 5-10 quality core pages (thin nahi) Day 3-7: Key pages par Request Indexing; homepage → hub internal links set; 3-5 zero-KD long-tail blogs publish (AEO format ma) Week 2-4: Bing/others submit; 2-3 quality backlinks/citations (06 folder); GSC ma indexing status daily check; GBP (local hoy to) Month 2-3: Cluster expansion; position 4-20 pages optimize; Discover mate strong featured images; first report (11 folder)

t: 4. Su na karvu (shortcuts je pacho marse)

Fast = blockers kadvo + long-tail pasand karvo + internal links + patience. Trust Google evidence thi aape — ene force na kari shakay. Client ke team ne kyarey 1-2 divas nu promise nahi; aa timeline table batavo.

t: 2. Risk pehla samjo (CONFIRMED — Google spam policy)
x: Scaled content abuse: ghana pages faqt rankings mate, value vagar = manual action. AI-generated hoy ke na hoy — value j matter kare. Doorway pages: same page faqt location/keyword swap sathe = violation. Rule of thumb: jo page koi real user mate specific question no unique answer na aapto hoy, to publish na karo. Drip publish karo — 1000 pages ek sathe nahi; 20-50/week jem quality prove thay tem vadharo.

GO (aa hoy to j) NO-GO Real, structured, unique data available chhe Faqt keyword list chhe, data nahi Dar page user nu specific question answer kare Template ma faqt city/word name badlay Search demand chhe (keyword research prove kare — 02 → 07) Pages faqt "sitemap bharva" mate Internal linking plan chhe (hub → template pages) Orphan thousands of pages Sample 20 pages manual quality pass thay 0 human review pipeline

Keyword pattern shodho — head term + modifier ("[service] in [city]", "[product] vs [product]", "[item] price in [city]"). Semrush Keyword Magic ma pattern filters (03 → 06). Template design karo — H1 pattern, intro (unique per row), data table, comparison, FAQ schema, CTA, related links. Unique value layer — dar page par minimum 2-3 elements je bija page thi sach ma alag hoy (data, images, local proof, expert note). Aa j doorway thi bachave. Sample batch (20 pages) — manual QA: on-page checklist (03 → 06 Step 8) + AI-made na lage test (04 → 01) + indexing test (publish → GSC ma 1-2 week ma index thay?) Drip publish — 20-50/week; GSC ma "Crawled - currently not indexed" monitor karo (aa signal = Google quality pass nathi kartu → STOP, improve template) Internal linking — hub page → badha template pages; template pages → sibling pages (related). 3-click rule maintain (15 folder). Sitemap update + IndexNow (Bing) — Google mate sitemap + internal links j.

t: 1. Ecommerce vs Lead Gen — su badlay

t: 2. Page architecture (03 → 15 NAVI architecture sathe match kare)
x: Ek page per service — buyer intent pramane, internal jargon pramane nahi. Customer "drain cleaning" search kare, "hydro-jetting solutions" nahi. Ek page per city/service-area — fakta jya sach ma service aapo. Same template 50 cities ma faqt name badalvu = doorway pages (CONFIRMED: Google spam policy). Dar city page par unique content: local proof, local reviews, area specifics. Proof pages — case studies per vertical (residential/commercial), reviews hub, before/after gallery. Homepage → Services hub → Service pages → City pages. Blog cluster service pages ne support kare.

t: 3. Service page must-haves (rank + convert banne mate)
x: Headline: service + city + USP (3 second ma khabar pade) Scope: su include chhe ane su nahi — vagueness conversion mare Price range ke "starting at" ke quote process (khotu price kyarey nahi — audit PDF rule same) Timeline expectation (kitla divas/kalak) Service area clarity + payment/financing info Ek direct CTA — call, form, WhatsApp (above the fold + end ma) Schema: Service + LocalBusiness + FAQ (08 → 04) Reviews/proof same page par

High-margin services pehla — vanity traffic nahi (volume karta job value juvo) Buyer-stage terms: "cost", "quote", "installer", "contractor near me", "emergency + service + city" Location-modified: "city + service" ane "service + near me" Low-margin emergency terms = alag page/messaging (qualification steps sathe) Keyword research process same: 02 → 07 + 03 → 06 (Semrush SOP)
