t: UI/UX - AI-made na lage aevu design
x: 2026 ma AI websites same-look thai gay chhe - same gradients, same layout, robotic text. User 3 second ma identify kari jay ane trust ghate. Human feel = easy to read + natural flow.

Vanchvama easy: body text no font size 16px+, line height 1.5+, contrast strong rakho (white par light gray text = fail). Bad paragraphs avoid karo: lamba 10-line paragraphs nahi. 2-4 lines nu paragraph, vachche subheadings, bullet lists. AI text patterns avoid karo: "In today's fast-paced world", "delve into", "unlock the power" - aa words dekhata j user jaani jay. Simple, direct bhasha lakho.

Real photos (team, office, products) - stock images minimum rakho Real customer na words (reviews, testimonials names sathe) Brand nu consistent voice (formal/friendly - pan consistent) Whitespaces screen bharelu na dekhay
Page ne 5 second juvo ane pucho: "Aa page su kehve chhe?" Answer na male to redesign.

Font 16px+, contrast pass, 2-4 line na paragraphs AI-typical words hataavela Real photos/testimonials present chhe 5-second clarity test pass thayelo Mobile friendly design — 4 steps 1 ▱ Open the site on a phone first Most visitors are on mobile. Design for them first. 2 ⌕ Run the mobile checks Text size, button size, menus, forms — the doc lists each. 3 ⚡ Make it fast on mobile data Slow on 4G = visitors gone. 4 ✓ Test on a real phone A real device, not just the computer's preview. Jaruri chhe.
India ma 75%+ traffic mobile par thi aave chhe. Google mobile-first indexing use kare - mobile version j Google ni nazar ma real site chhe. Desktop par saru ane mobile par kharab = rank kharab.

Responsive test: Chrome DevTools (F12 → mobile view) ma dar page check karo, ke Google Lighthouse run karo. Touch targets: buttons/links min 44px, besedha links touch na thay. No horizontal scroll: images/tables mobile width ma fit thay. Vanchva layak font: zoom vagar vanchay evu. Popups ma savdhan raho: mobile par full-screen popup = Google penalty risk.
Images WebP format ma compress karela 4G connection par 3 second ma load thavu joiye (PageSpeed Insights mobile score check)
Emulator perfect batave pan real phone ma issues hoy. 1 Android + 1 iPhone ma kholi ne juvo: menu khule? Forms fill thay? Buttons dabay?

Mobile par Core Web Vitals pass (Lighthouse 90+ goal) Real device test thai gayo (Android + iPhone) Mobile par intrusive popups na hova joiye Badha forms/buttons thumb-friendly hova joiye Competitor design & features study — 3 steps 1 ⚲ Open the competitor pool's websites From folder 02's pool. 2 ☰ Note their design and features Layouts, sections, tools, little details that work. 3 ➜ Pick what fits us, skip the rest Output in the doc's format. Adapt, never copy.
Design reinvent karva ni jarur nathi - competitors ma su work kare chhe te study karo, pachhi te thi better banao.

Top 5 competitors ni sites kholo (mobile desktop banne). Screenshot + notes: homepage nu layout, navigation, product/service page nu structure, checkout/inquiry flow. Features list: kaya tools/features offer kare chhe? (calculators, WhatsApp chat, comparison tables, size guides, EMI option...) Trust signals note karo: reviews shu batave, guarantees, certificates, payment badges. Temni UX mistakes note karo: slow pages, confusing menu, lamba forms - aa tamara opportunity chhe.
Feature comparison table: Feature | Comp 1-5 | Tamara ma chhe? | Priority "Must have" (badha pase chhe) vs "Nice to have" (1-2 pase) vs "Differentiator" (koi pase nathi)

5 competitors na design notes + screenshots Feature comparison table taiyar chhe 1 week ma thai shake eva 3 quick improvements identify karo New features & tools — 3 steps 1 ☰ List feature ideas for your website type The doc has ideas per site type (ecommerce, service, blog). 2 ⚖ Pick by the criteria Useful to visitors? Affordable? Can we maintain it? 3 ✓ Add one at a time Ship, measure, then the next.
Website static brochure na hovi joiye. Interactive tools (calculators, quizzes, configurators) engagement vadharave, time-on-site increase kare, ane backlinks pan aape - badha SEO signals.

Ecommerce: size calculator, EMI calculator, product comparison, bundle builder Service: cost estimator, booking calendar, WhatsApp click-to-chat, portfolio filter Blog/content: quizzes, checklists download, interactive infographics B2B: ROI calculator, case study library, demo booking

Customer nu real problem solve kare (Client Ask point 4 juvo) Build effort vs SEO/business value - simple tool je use thay > complex tool je koine na khabar hoy Tool ne proper page aapo - indexable URL, content, schema (SoftwareApplication/WebApplication)

Customer na problems pramane 1-2 tools select karela chhe Tool nu dedicated indexable page planned Tool nu promotion plan (blog + social + newsletter) Theme, motion & consistency — 3 steps 1 ▶ Fix theme and motion rules once Colors, fonts, animation style — decided once, written down. 2 ↻ Use them the same on every page One site, one feel. No page should look like a different website. 3 ✓ Consistency checklist per page The doc's checklist catches drift.
Notebook ma point 7: "Motion & movement theme properly follow, consistency on all pages". Animation saru lage, pan har page par different animation = unprofessional ane slow site.

Ek motion language: same animation style badha pages par (da. fade-up on scroll). 2-3 animation types max, badhu j mix nahi. Speed limit: animations 300-500ms - slow animation site slow lage. Performance check: animation library heavy hoy (large JS) to page speed score tapas o - Core Web Vitals (LCP/INP/CLS) bagde nahi. Reduced motion respect karo: koi users motion-sensitive hoy - CSS prefers-reduced-motion support.

Colors: 1 primary + 1 secondary + 1 accent - 5 colors mix nahi Fonts: vadhu ma vadhu 2 fonts (heading + body) Button styles ek jevi (color, radius, hover effect) Spacing system (8px na multiples) Header/footer identical badha pages par

EEAT = Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness. E-E-A-T Google na Quality Rater Guidelines no concept chhe (direct ranking factor nathi), pan Google na systems trustworthy ane helpful content ne reward kare chhe - khas karine jo site health, finance, ya shopping related hoy (YMYL - Your Money Your Life).

Experience: content lakhelu aeva vyakti pase thi jeney real experience chhe. Real photos, personal examples, "ame aa try karyu" style proof. Expertise: author bio with credentials, technical depth content ma, accurate information. Authoritativeness: industry ma recognition - backlinks, mentions, reviews, certifications. Trustworthiness: HTTPS, clear contact info, privacy policy, return/refund policy, real address/phone, ane secure payment.

Old SEO vs New SEO (30 sec) Old: Google ma rank thavu ej game — keyword + backlink. New: Google AI badhe retrieve + cite + trust thavu. GEO = smart waiter: tamari info clear hoy to j tamne confidently recommend kare. Formulas AEO: ASK → ANSWER → FORMAT → PROVE → MEASURE GEO: ENTITY → ANSWER → ORIGINAL → TRUST → SOURCES → TEST

t: DA PA Vadharvani & Backlink Health (Monthly SOP)
x: Source: "DA PA Vadharvani Guide (SOP)" — Client C, myhealinghands, valonudairyfarm na real data par thi. Ahiya general bhaag chhe je koi pan client mate kaam aave. Mahatva ni note (CONFIRMED) DA ane PA Moz na metric chhe, Google eno use ranking mate nathi kartu (Moz ane Google banne e public ma kahyu chhe). Pan je kaam DA vadhare chhe (relevant ane quality backlinks), ae j kaam Google ranking ane traffic ma pan madad kare chhe. Etle focus "DA number" par nahi, "saara unique relevant domains" par rakhvo. Client ne report karta DA saathe GSC clicks, impressions ane sales pan batavva.

DA PA vadharvano asli rasto ek j chhe: vadhu alag-alag, relevant ane strong websites (linking root domains) thi backlinks melavva, ane malela links ne sachavva. Traffic, domain age ane internal links Moz na DA formula ma direct count nathi thata.

DA (Domain Authority): Moz no score (1 thi 100) je batave chhe ke aakhu domain ketlu strong chhe, Moz na backlink data mujab. Aa Google no score nathi. PA (Page Authority): Ek specific page (URL) no score. Ae page ne ketla ane kevi quality na links male chhe te par aadhar rakhe chhe. Etle PA, DA karta vadhu pan hoi shake. Linking root domain: Je unique website link aape chhe te. Ek site thi 50 links male to pan ae 1 j root domain ganay. Log scale: DA no scale saman nathi. 0 thi 20 sudhi pahochvu saral chhe, 20 thi 30 mate ghana vadhu strong links joie, ane 40 pachhi dar point bahu mehnat thi aave.

t: 10. DA PA ghati shake? Haa: kem ane su karvu
x: DA ane PA permanent score nathi. Etle sirf links banavva puratu nathi, malela links ne sachavva pan jaruri chhe. DA kem ghate Backlinks lost thai jay: link aapti site no page delete thai jay, site band thai jay, ke te link hatavi de. Profile ane directory links ma aa vadhu thay chhe. Linking sites pote weak thai jay: tamne link aapti site no DA ghate, to tena link ni value pan ghate. DA comparative (relative) score chhe: tamari site same rahe pan bija sites vadhu strong thai jay, to tamaro DA 1-2 point ghati shake. Moz na index ke formula ma update: Moz update kare tyare ghani sites na DA ek saathe upar-niche thai jay (2019 na Moz DA 2.0 update ma moto farak aavyo hato). Spam links ni value ochhi gane: free ad forum jeva links par aadhar hoy to aa risk chhe. DA drop aave to su karvu Drop ketlo? Matlab Su karvu 1-2 point Normal upar-niche Kai khaas nahi. Regular link building chalu rakho. 3-4 point Dhyan aapva jevu Moz ma Lost Links ane Linking Domains no trend jovo. Kai mukhya sites na links gaya te shodho. 5+ point Moto drop Lost links ni list banavo ane link reclamation karo. Check karo ke Moz e koi update karyo chhe ke nahi (te vakhte ghani sites ma ek saathe drop dekhay). DA stable kevi rite rakhvo Links ghana alag-alag, strong ane relevant sites thi lavo. Aava links lambo samay tike chhe. Free profile ane classified links par aadhar na rakho. Ae jaldi aave chhe ane jaldi jay pan chhe. Dar mahine thoda-thoda navi links banavta raho, ek j mahine 100 links banavi ne band na karo. Moz Link Explorer ma Lost Links ane Linking Domains dar mahine jovo, ane tracking sheet nu Status update karo.

Free classified ane ad forum sites par saikdo links banavva. Ek j site thi ghana links lai ne khush thavu, unique domains na badle. Fakt homepage par links lavva. Dar link ma exact keyword anchor vaparvo. Paid link packages kharidva je "DA 50 in 30 days" jeva promise kare. Links banavi ne bhuli javu, lost links check na karva. DA ne Google ranking factor samji levo.

Moz par DA, PA, Spam Score ane Linking Root Domains note karya. GSC Links report export karyo. Dar domain mate 5 thi 10 navi unique relevant sites target kari. Navi links tracking sheet ma add kari. Lost links check karya ane reclamation try karyu. Spammy ad-forum ke classified sites par koi navi link nathi banavi. Manager/client report ma DA saathe GSC clicks, impressions ane sales pan batavya. URL badlay, page delete thay, product band thay - dar vakhte saacho status code jaruri chhe. Galat handling = backlinks waste, users frustrated, crawl budget waste.

Normal chhe - badha 404 problem nathi. 410: page kayam mate gayu - Google 404 jevu j treat kare (farak bahu nano). t: 18. Minimum-deployment strategy – reusable across all projects
x: Goal: reliable dashboard with minimum unnecessary Vercel deployments, GitHub API reads/writes, GSC queries, automation runs and AI/token usage. 18.1 Recommended architecture: deploy code rarely, update data separately Layer Minimum strategy Why it saves usage Hosting One Vercel project per genuinely separate app/repo. If multiple sites use the same dashboard, use one shared multi-site app with a config-driven site list. Avoid duplicate projects and repeated build/deploy work. Deployments Deploy only for code/config changes. Keep feature work on Preview; Production only after approval. A data refresh does not require a new deployment. Data Keep one canonical GitHub JSON snapshot; partition only if file size becomes a measured problem. One merge/write per scheduled batch. API A small number of serverless endpoints serves all site keys using query parameters. Avoid 13 copies of the same API. Scheduler One scheduled job loops through configured properties. Avoid one automation per property and duplicate polling. Health One health check after a successful data commit. Avoid high-frequency checks. Secrets Least-privilege read-only GitHub token per deployment/repo security boundary. Reduce secret sprawl and permission surface. 18.2 Deployment decision rule Data-only change (new rows in data.json): do not redeploy Vercel. The API reads the latest GitHub main snapshot when requested. Dashboard/API code change: push one reviewed commit to migration/vercel; Git integration creates one Preview deployment. Preview passes and release approved: follow the production release process. Do not deploy for each daily data refresh. More properties in same dashboard: add a site config entry; do not clone the entire dashboard/API for every site. Different client/team with separate secrets, access rules, billing or branding: use a separate project/repo when isolation is needed. Batch related code/config edits and deploy once; environment-variable changes also require a new deployment to take effect. 18.3 Keep GitHub, GSC and API usage low GSC: one Search Analytics query per property per daily run for the required date window; use only required dimensions (date) and metrics. Do not repeat identical queries in the same run. Backfill: query only missing/recent dates or a deliberate bounded lookback; merge by date key idempotently. GitHub: prepare the merged JSON in memory and commit once after all properties are processed; avoid one commit per site/date. Scheduler GitHub reads: read source once before merge and read back once after commit for validation. Dashboard: fetch only the selected site and selected date range; do not fetch all 13 sites on every page view unless portfolio totals require it. Health: run once after commit; no polling every few seconds. No-op: if content is unchanged, skip the commit and record “no new finalized GSC rows”; never trigger a deployment for a no-op. Retries: retry transient 429/5xx with exponential backoff and a small maximum attempt count;

Google Analytics 4 (GA4) is the latest version of Google’s analytics platform, offering enhanced tracking, better insights, and improved data accuracy compared to Universal Analytics (UA). Key Areas in GA4 Acquisition (Avyo Kyathi) - How users are arriving on your website/app. Engagement (Kam Su Karu) - How users interact with your content. Monetization (Kai Work Karu Ke Nai?) - Tracking revenue-generating activities. Retention (Return User Avo Ke Nai) - Measuring returning visitors.
Old Name: Universal Analytics (UA) New Name: Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
Age: Tracks user age distribution. City: Identifies users’ locations based on city-level data.
Device: Tracks user activity across different device types (Mobile, Desktop, Tablet).
2005: Introduction of Urchin Analytics. 2013: Launch of Universal Analytics (UA). 2020: Web + App integration introduced. 2024: Google Analytics 4 (GA4) becomes the default analytics tool.

Acquisition Overview: A summary of how users find your website. User Acquisition: Tracks new users and their traffic sources. Traffic Acquisition: Monitors overall site traffic, including returning users.

Engagement Session: A session is considered "engaged" if it lasts at least 10 seconds. Engagement Rate: The percentage of engaged sessions out of total sessions. Events & Conversions: User interactions tracked as events, such as clicks, form submissions, or purchases. Cohorts: Groups users based on shared characteristics over a specific time period.
User Overview: Provides insights into user behavior, demographics, and engagement levels. User Details: Analyzes individual user data, including retention and activity patterns.

Event (User Actions): Tracked as "work" within GA4. Automatic & Custom Events: GA4 automatically tracks major events, while custom events can be defined based on business needs. Common Events: Page_View: Tracks views on a specific page. Page_Location: Captures the URL of the visited page.

Dimensions (Qualitative Attributes) Definition: Attributes of your data. Examples: City: Surat, Delhi, etc. Device Type: Mobile, Desktop, Tablet. Metrics (Quantitative Data) Definition: Numeric data used to measure performance. Examples: User Count: 1,000 users. Conversion Rate: 1%.

GA4: A reporting tool for tracking user behavior and interactions. GTM (Google Tag Manager): A tag management tool used to fire tracking codes and send data to GA4. Process Flow: Capture Data: GA4 collects event-based data. Processing: Data is processed into meaningful insights. Reporting: Generates detailed analytics reports. Data Analysis: Provides deep insights for business decisions.

GA4 is a powerful analytics tool that provides a deeper understanding of user behavior. With advanced features like event-based tracking, AI-powered insights, and cross-platform analysis, it enables businesses to make data-driven decisions effectively. 🔹 Stay ahead by leveraging GA4’s advanced analytics to optimize your website and improve user experience! 🚀 SEO vs AIO vs GEO vs AEO

t: 1. Core Principles: Modern Search Framework (SEO + GEO + AEO + SXO)
x: Traditional search optimization focused solely on keyword placement and backlinks to earn top positions in standard search engine results pages. Modern search requires a unified strategy across four foundational pillars: Pillar Focus Area Execution Strategy SEO Traditional Search Keyword targeting, technical architecture, and internal linking to rank in Google blue links. AEO Answer Engines Placing a concise 40–60 word summary at the top of content to capture Featured Snippets and voice answers. GEO / AIO Generative AI Optimizing for brand mentions and entity citations inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. SXO Search Experience Improving core web vitals, mobile usability, fast load times, and conversion paths upon user arrival.

Experience & Expertise: Content must feature verified author credentials, direct hands-on observations, and authentic domain knowledge. Authoritativeness & Trust: Zero tolerance for fake stats or hallucinated data. Every claim must be backed by accurate source citation or primary research.
Keep discovery and optimization workflows strictly separated to prevent scope creep and keyword cannibalization.

Analyze Niche: Define exact target topics based on primary products, services, and core audience pain points. Map Existing Assets: Catalog all published blogs, URLs, and landed keywords across the domain. Build Exclusion Map: Cross-reference prospective topics against existing URLs to ensure no overlapping keyword intent. Identify Gaps: Select unaddressed user questions and informational queries that map directly back to business services or catalog products.

Export GSC Data: Filter Google Search Console performance data for the last 3 months. Isolate Striking Distance Queries: Filter for queries occupying positions 5–20 with high impressions but low click-through rates (CTR). Cluster & Map: Group related striking-distance queries around a single central topic. Create Supporting Assets: Write high-intent informational blogs targeting these query clusters. Funnel Page Equity: Link all new supporting articles directly back to primary commercial/money pages (never create competing commercial landing pages).

Rule Requirement Implementation 1 Page = 1 Primary Keyword Core Focus Include within the Page Title (first 50–60 characters), URL slug, H1 tag, and naturally within the first 100 words. 3–5 Secondary Keywords Context & Depth Distribute across H2/H3 subheadings, body paragraphs, and dedicated FAQ sections. Intent Alignment Match Searcher Goal Informational: Educational blogs/guides.Commercial: Product comparisons/reviews.Transactional: Service or product sales pages. Winnability Check Feasibility First For new or growing domains, target low-difficulty keywords (KD 0–30) rather than broad high-volume terms.

Relevance Limit: Feature a maximum of 5 closely related products from your store catalog per article. Anchor Text Rule: Avoid using exact, full product names in running prose. Instead, use natural, 2–5 word lowercase descriptive anchor text (e.g., use "lightweight running shoes" instead of "Men's Apex VaporFly Pro 2024 Edition").
Include product visual callouts using the structured layout below: Alt text: [lowercase natural descriptive alt text] (space for photo)

Integrate the targeted parent category or collection URL exactly 2 times within the article body. Use rich, descriptive anchor text. Never use generic anchors such as "click here", "link", or "buy now".

Copy and paste the prompt block below directly into ChatGPT, Claude, or your preferred LLM to generate content matching these exact parameters.t You are an expert SEO content writer and subject matter expert. Write a comprehensive, highly engaging, and actionable blog post based on the following rules: TARGETING & INTENT: Primary Keyword: [INSERT PRIMARY KEYWORD] Secondary Keywords: [INSERT 3-5 SECONDARY KEYWORDS] Target Audience: [INSERT AUDIENCE] Search Intent: Informational (Educational guide that naturally references solutions) STRUCTURE & AEO OPTIMIZATION: Title: Craft an enticing, SEO-optimized title with the primary keyword in the first 50-60 characters. Introduction: Start with a clear hook. Within the first 100 words, provide a direct 40-60 word concise answer (AEO Block) summarizing the entire topic for instant retrieval by answer engines. Headings: Use clear H2 and H3 tags. Integrate secondary keywords naturally into subheadings. Core Content: Practical, step-by-step guidance. Use bullet points and short, scannable paragraphs. No filler, fluff, or generic theoretical commentary. PRODUCT INTEGRATION & LINKING (SOP COMPLIANT): Recommend maximum 3-5 relevant products/solutions related to [INSERT PRODUCT CATEGORY]. Apply the exact image placeholder format for product callouts: Alt text: [lowercase natural descriptive alt text] (space for photo) Anchor Text Rule: Do NOT use full brand/product names in text. Use 2-5 words natural, lowercase descriptive anchor text. Include exactly 2 links to the main collection page ([INSERT COLLECTION URL]) using contextually rich, descriptive anchor text. Never use generic phrases like "click here". E-E-A-T & TRUST REQUIREMENTS: Sound authoritative, professional, and empathetic. Present accurate, actionable facts. Do not invent fake statistics, studies, or unverified claims. Add a dedicated FAQ section at the end targeting common long-tail questions. Generate the full blog article now following these exact instructions. ## 6. Monthly Execution & Measurement SOP Week 1: Performance Audit └─ Export 3-month GSC data and identify striking-distance opportunities (positions 5-20). Week 2: Mapping & De-duplication └─ Assign 1 primary keyword per URL and resolve any keyword cannibalization across existing pages. Week 3: Content Production └─ Publish AEO-structured articles with contextual internal links directing traffic to core money pages. Week 4: Review & Refinement └─ Track impression growth, CTR changes, and ranking shifts; adjust topics for the upcoming cycle. ### Implementation Checklist * **Week 1 (Audit):** Pull GSC metrics. Filter for keywords ranking in positions 5–20 with strong impressions. Identify underperforming pages with low CTR. * **Week 2 (Keyword Mapping):** Map exactly one primary keyword per target page. Check existing URLs to fix cannibalization before creating new content. * **Week 3 (Publishing):** Execute articles using the AEO framework. Build contextual internal links using proper desc

t: 1. Old SEO ≠ New SEO — game badli gayi
x: Pehla: Google ma rank thavu ej ek-matr game hatu — page one par na aavo to "exist" ja nahi. Aaje: success etle Google + AI platforms badhe retrieve, cite ane trust thavu. Visibility have GEO + AEO + AIO + SXO par bane chhe. Old SEO New SEO Focus Google ranking only Google + AI ma retrieval + citation Content Keyword stuffing, thin content pan rank Original, structured, trustworthy Backlinks Koi pan backlink counted Proof + authority matter Winner Page one = success Brand found, surfaced ne chosen Risk 1 algo update = traffic gayu Long-term authority tike End goal Page-one rank, clicks = victory Retrieve → Cite → Trust → Convert Old SEO haju quick traffic hacks mate kaam laage, pan aaje AI tools ma retrieval/citation vagar visibility adhuri chhe.

One line each: SEO — traditional search (Google) ma rank karvu. GEO — AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude…) tamaru brand reference/cite kare. AEO — search par direct answer banvu (snippet, voice). AIO — AI Overview (Google AI Overview, Bing Copilot) ma dekhavu. SXO — user site par aavya pachhi no experience optimize karvo (UX + conversion). Pillar Shu means Kem kaam kare (signals) Real example SEO Search Engine Opt. Google jeva engine ma high rank Keyword research, on-page, quality backlinks, technical SEO "best running shoes" → ranked blog "10 Best Running Shoes 2026" GEO Generative Engine Opt. AI models brand ne reference kare AI-friendly content, structured data, expert authority, trusted sources AI ne "Best CRM software?" → HubSpot · Salesforce · Zoho (cited) AEO Answer Engine Opt. Search par direct answer banvu Question-based content, clear concise answers, FAQ schema, zero-click "What is digital marketing?" → clear definition first dekhaay AIO AI Overview Opt. AI-generated overview ma dekhavu Topical authority, multi-source credibility, semantic relevance, entity optimization "CRM software comparison" → AI Overview sources: HubSpot · Salesforce · Zoho SXO Search Experience Opt. Landing pachi UX + conversion Fast loading, mobile-friendly, clear CTA, trust signals Landing page "Run Further" → Shop Now (Fast · Mobile · Trusted) Note: AIO ne kayak jagyae "AI Integration Optimization" pan kahe chhe (content ne AI tools/APIs vaapri shake evi rite structure karvi) — concept same: AI-usable content.

AEO etle: user na question no clear, direct answer aapvo, jethi Google na answer-box / featured snippet ma dekhaay. Featured snippet ane zero-click aa j family chhe. Analogy — busy teacher: Google ne busy teacher samjo. "Aaje homework kone anyu?" — 10 min ni story kaho to teacher confuse. "Sir, homework aa file ma chhe" — instant clear. AEO aa j: answer first, story later. Search intent — AEO nu foundation: same keyword, alag intent. Answer aapta pehla user shu karva mange chhe e pakdo: Informational → "What is piles?" → definition How-to → "How to treat at home?" → numbered steps Comparison → "Medicine vs surgery" → table Commercial → "Best piles medicine" → options + proof Transactional → "Buy X" → product + CTA Local → "Best doctor in Surat" → local + reviews Golden rule: keyword nahi, intent vadhu important. Featured snippet: Google no highlighted answer box. Guarantee nathi, pan clean structure thi chance vadhe. Analogy: answer "plate saaf" kari ne aapo, spoon-feed nahi — machine mate extract easy bane. Zero-click: user ne SERP par j answer mali jaay, click na kare. Aa failure NATHI — visibility, brand ne authority pan value chhe. AEO formula: ASK → ANSWER → FORMAT → PROVE → MEASURE

GEO etle: AI systems (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI search) tamaru brand + content samje, trust kare ane answer ma cite/mention kare. Analogy — smart waiter: customer puche "aa area ma best healthy meal kya?" — tamari info (menu, location, reviews, mentions) badhe clear ne consistent hoy to waiter confidently recommend kare; adhuri/contradictory hoy to "khabar nathi bhai." AI ne pan evi j clear story joiye. AI ne 4 vaat joiye: ENTITY — tame kon chho (brand, service, location). ANSWER — user na questions solve thaay. ORIGINAL VALUE — internet par same na hoy evi useful info (data, case study, cost breakdown). TRUST — author, proof, reviews, honest claims + third-party mentions. Analogy 2: AI ne "guess the movie" na ramadvo — character, location, story badhu clearly aapo. GEO formula: ENTITY → ANSWER → ORIGINAL → TRUST → SOURCES → TEST

Shu chhe: LLMs.txt ek markdown file chhe je AI systems / LLMs ne samjave ke tamari website par kayu content sauthi important chhe. Robots.txt jem search crawlers ne guide karto, em LLMs.txt AI agents ne discover, interpret ane accurately cite karva ma help kare. Kem important (benefits): AI ne priority pages ane content structure samjaay. AI-powered search / assistants ma discoverability vadhe. AEO ne support kare. GEO strategy ne strong kare. Tamara valuable content ne structured access aape. Kem kaam kare (3 step): Tame LLMs.txt banavo. AI agents ene read/understand kare. Tamaru content AI systems dwara cite ne recommend thaay. Line yaad rakho: "Be the source AI chooses to cite." Content AI-friendly banavo. (More: llmstxt.org)

Real example: "Does piles medicine work immediately?" H1 = question j → "Does Piles Medicine Work Immediately?" Direct answer first (40–60 words, koi long intro nahi): Bad (answer chhupave): "Piles is a common condition… various treatment options available…" Good (answer first): "No. Piles medicine usually immediately kaam nathi karti. Kayak treatment kalak ma relief aape; noticeable improvement ma several days lage. Timeline type, severity, diet ane individual response par depend kare." Format = intent pramane — para / list / table / steps. H2 = follow-up questions (People Also Ask mathi): How long does it take? → timeline What affects recovery? → factors How to support recovery? → steps When to see a doctor? → warning signs FAQ = real user questions (fake FAQ nahi). Internal links → relevant service/category page. (Analogy: article = island, internal link = bridge; bridge vagar traffic atke.) Schema → page par jetlu actual content chhe etlu j accurate markup. Fake markup nahi. Measure → GSC ma impressions, clicks, queries, CTR joyo.

t: 7. Implementation B — same page ne AI-ready banavo (GEO)
x: Entity clear → About/page par: brand shu kare, kon mate, kya location. Website + Google Business Profile + LinkedIn + directories — badhe SAME info (consistency). Original value add → cost breakdown, first-party data, case study, real examples. Generic AI copy-paste nahi. Ecosystem banao → ek page nahi, connected pages: service + location + cost guide + comparison + FAQ + reviews + About. Third-party footprint → relevant directories, reviews, industry mentions — consistent. (500 spammy listings nahi; relevance + quality.) Test → same query ChatGPT / Gemini / Perplexity ma nakho: brand aavyu? cite thayu? competitor kayu? kayo source cite thayo? → gap fix karo, periodically retest. Platform focus (1 line each): Platform Shu par focus ChatGPT Clear entity + helpful content + trusted external sources Gemini Entity + Google Business + local/structured info Perplexity Original research + citation-friendly + sources Bing Copilot Bing indexable + entity + local proof Note: algorithms change thaay — fixed formula na samajo, real queries thi test karta raho.

Common mistakes (na karo): Answer 5 paragraph pachhi aapvo (answer hiding). Keyword stuffing — same question 20 vaar. Fake FAQ, fake reviews, fake stats, unsupported medical/legal claims. Page par na hoy e schema markup (schema abuse). Generic AI article copy-paste — original value 0. Optimize kari ne measure na karvu. 10-minute practice: ek keyword lo → user no exact question → intent → 40–60 word direct answer → 5 follow-up questions → darek no format → 2 internal links → 1–2 proof → page structure → publish → GSC ne AI ma check. Copy-paste template: Primary keyword: ___ User question: ___ Search intent: ___ Direct answer (40–60w): ___ Follow-up Qs (5): ___ Format per Q: ___ Proof / source: ___ Internal links (2): ___ Schema: ___ CTA: ___ AI test (ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity): ___ Next action: ___

t: 9. E-E-A-T — Trust layer (AEO + GEO banne mate)
x: E-E-A-T etle Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness. Google ne ane AI — badhe joiye chhe ke content pachhal koi real, credible vyakti chhe. AEO ma answer par trust aavva mate ane GEO ma AI cite kare e mate aa layer j foundation chhe. (Yaad rakho: AEO formula ma PROVE ane GEO formula ma TRUST — aa e j vaat chhe.) 4 parts (simple): Experience — topic no first-hand/real experience (tame kharekhar use karyu/joyu chhe?). Expertise — content lakhnaar ni knowledge/skill (doctor, practitioner, specialist). Authoritativeness — field ma brand/author ni reputation (biju kon tamne reference kare?). Trustworthiness — accuracy, honesty, safety — sauthi important part. Analogy: E-E-A-T etle resume + reference check. Interview ma tame gme te kaho, pan certificate, experience ane referral hoy to j employer trust kare. Google/AI pan evi j rite content trust kare. Page par kem implement karvu: Clear author info — name, photo, short bio, credentials. High-stakes topics (health, legal, finance = YMYL) mate expert review/author batavo. Credible sources cite karo (gov, research, official). Original data / real experience / case studies add karo. Transparent claims — limitations honestly kaho. Update — facts badle tyare content update karo (updated date batavo). Author/expert page banavo ane relevant articles sathe link karo. Kadi na karo (red flags): Fake expertise ke fake credentials. Fake statistics / fake reviews / fake citations. Unsupported medical / legal / financial claims. Aa badhu fake hoy to short-term kadaach chale, pan trust ane long-term visibility — banne bagade.

Google ne trick karvano nahi — user + machine banne ne clear, useful, trustworthy answer aapvano. AI ne impress nahi karvano; AI ne confuse na thava devano. SEO: page rank. AEO: user no direct answer. GEO: AI tamne samje ne cite kare. AIO: AI Overview ma dekhavu. SXO: site par saaru experience + conversion. Flow: Structure → Retrieve → Cite → Trust → Convert. Website Monitoring & SEO Analytics Complete Guide Monitoring Shu Chhe? (What is Monitoring?) Monitoring etle tamari website nu performance regular basis par check karta rehvu. AA process thi tamne khabar pade chhe ke kaya pages sara perform kare chhe ane kaya pages ma traffic ghati rahyo chhe. Performance Tracking: Continuous tracking thi website ni health jalvai rahe chhe. Proactive Action: Issues ne vadhare mota thaya pehla j solve kari shakay chhe. Essential Monitoring & SEO Tools Website health ane traffic grow karva mate niche aapeIa core tools khub j zaroori chhe: Google Analytics 4 (GA4): Website par kon aave chhe, kaya source (Google, Social Media, Direct) thi aave chhe ane site par ketlo time spend kare chhe te check karva mate. Google Search Console (GSC): Google search ma site nu ranking, search keywords, clicks, impressions ane indexing issues check karva mate. SEMrush / Ahrefs: Competitor analysis, keyword rank tracking, and backlink audit mate best enterprise tools. Google Looker Studio (Add-on): GA4 ane GSC no data visually interactive dashboard ma dekhadva mate free Google tool. Weekly Check-up Routine (Keviri Rite Check Karvu?) Ek fixed routine follow karvathi data analysis saral bani jaay chhe: Step 1: GA4 ane GSC accounts open karo. Step 2: Last 7 days no data pichla 7 days sathe compare karo. Step 3: Jo koi main page par traffic 10% thi vadhare drop thayo hoy, to turant dhyan aapo ane audit karo. Step 4: New keywords, gainers, ane high-ranking queries ne sheet ma note karo. Traffic Ghati Jaay To Content Update Keviri Rite Karvu? Traffic drop thava par aa practical action steps follow karo: Fresh Content Add Karo: Nayi facts, recent case studies ke 2026 ni updated tips uméro. Visuals Improve Karo: High-resolution images, original charts ke relevant video embeds add karo. Search Intent Match Karo: User je query search kare chhe teno direct answer pehla 100 words ma aapo. Internal Linking: Website na bija relevant, high-traffic pages mathi aa page par links aapo. Core Web Vitals Check (Add-on): Page load speed ochhi nathi thay gayi ne te PageSpeed Insights ma check karo. Organic traffic vadharvu ane tech articles na strategic keywords ne Top 5 results ma rank karva.

Traffic Growth: Organic traffic last month karta +15% vadhyo. User Engagement: Average engagement time 1m 20s thi vadhi ne 2m 10s thayo. Top Keyword Jump: Keyword 'latest tech gadgets' position 10 mathi jump kari ne position 5 par aavya.
Total Sessions: 10,000 (Pehla 8,700 hata) New Users: 6,500 Top Traffic Source: Organic Search (65% share)

Smartphone review page ne update karo jethi lost ranking pachi aave. AI Trends par navu topic cluster content create karo. Fast-growing pages par newsletter signup popups optimize karo. t: 1. Google Discover Shu Chhe? (What is Discover?)
x: Google Discover acts as a personalized feed tailored directly to every user's interests, similar to social media feeds on Instagram or Facebook. Personalized Feed: Jem Instagram ke Facebook par tamaru Personal Feed / Scroll hoy chhe, evuj aa Google nu Feed chhe. Query-less Discovery: Ahiya user e kashu Search nathi karvu padtu. Google pote user na interest ane search history pramane articles, videos ane blogs samethi batavse. Surge Potential: Etle j amathi aavto traffic achanak (surprise traffic) aavi shake chhe.

t: 2. Website Discover ma Keviri Rite Aave? (Eligibility Requirements)
x: Getting into Discover requires zero special code or plugins—it operates automatically once technical and content standards are met. Automatic Process: Aa ekdam automatic chhe, koi special setting ke code ni jarur nathi. Two Fundamental Rules (Be basic sharato): Indexing Required: Website Google ma Index thayeli hovi joie (Google ne khabar hovi joie ke site exist kare chhe). Policy Compliance: Content Google ni Content Policies (spam na hovu joie, dangerous content na hovu joie) nu palan kartu hovu joie. Important Note: Dhyan rakho: Eligible hovano matlav guarantee nathi ke tame Discover ma dekhasho j.

t: 3. Discover ma Aavvana Chances Keviri Rite Vadharva? (Optimization Action Steps)
x: Follow these technical and editorial best practices to optimize your content visibility:
Title evu lakho je article nu sachu varnan kartu hoy. Clickbait thi bacho (khoota shocking shabdo vapari loko ne lalachavva nahi).
Discover moti ane attractive images ne vadhare pasand kare chhe. Main image ni width ochha ma ochhi 1200 pixels hovi joie. Website no logo kyarey main image tarike na vapro.
Matra click melavva mate bhamrak title, summary ke photo na vapro.

Trending Topics: Je topics atyare trending ma chhe tena par lakho. Good Storytelling: Vanchak ne maja aave tevi rite saral vat karo. Unique Insights: Bije kyay na male tevi potani navi mahiti uméro. Avoid Outrage: Gussa ke outrage felave tevu content na banavo.
Chrome browser allows users to directly follow websites to receive newly published updates directly into their Discover feed.

Website par RSS ke Atom feed hovi joie (WordPress ma by default hoy chhe). Website na <head> section ma aa link tag add karo: <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" href=" https://yourwebsite.com/feed/"\ >

t: 5. Discover no Traffic Kem Vadhat-Ghatat Thay Chhe? (Understanding Volatility)
x: Discover traffic is inherently volatile compared to organic search traffic. Factor Description & Impact Shift in User Interest Loko no ras badlay to Google oochhu batavse. Content naturally trends in and out of interest cycles. Algorithm Updates Core algorithm updates thi traffic badlay shake chhe without prior warning. Expected Behavior Discover no traffic fix nathi rahyo—ek divase lakhoma views aave ane bija divase ghani ochhi thay shake chhe. Traffic ghate to dar vakhte tamari bhul j hoy tevu jaruri nathi.

t: 6. Performance Keviri Rite Check Karvu? (Tracking & Analytics)
x: To monitor impressions, clicks, and average CTR for Discover content: Google Search Console (GSC) open karo. Left side menu mathi Performance > Discover report par jaav. Tya tamne Clicks, Impressions, ane CTR (Click-Through Rate) dekhase. t: Q: Technical SEO ma su su check karo cho?
x: Answer: "Screaming Frog / SEMrush thi complete crawl karu, ane issues ne Errors → Warnings → Notices priority ma fix karu." Crawlability: robots.txt directive blocks evaluation XML sitemap validation & indexability check Server response status codes handling (200, 301, 404, 5xx) Indexing Directives: Meta robots tag inspection (noindex, nofollow) Incorrect canonical tag mapping & self-referential validation Identification and resolution of orphan pages Core Web Vitals & Performance Metrics: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint): < 2.5s INP (Interaction to Next Paint): < 200ms CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift): < 0.1 Redirect Management: Elimination of 301/302 redirect chains Zero tolerance for active redirect loops Mobile-First Optimization: Mobile viewport configuration, tap targets spacing, and responsive layout integrity Security Protocols: HTTPS/SSL certificate enforcement & mixed content error resolution Structured Data: Schema.org syntax validation & rich snippet eligibility checks Duplicate Content & Architecture: Faceted navigation canonicalization & duplicate content mitigation Social Metadata: Open Graph and Twitter Card tags (og:title, og:image, og:description)

t: Q: Crawl Budget etle su ane XML Sitemap vs Robots.txt no farak?
x: Crawl Budget: Googlebot site par limited pages crawl kare chhe. Jo low-value, duplicate ke 404 pages vadhi jaay to important money pages crawl na thay. Unwanted URL parameters ane low-quality pages noindex or disallow karva pade. XML Sitemap vs Robots.txt: XML Sitemap: Google ne kehavu "Aa pages exist kare chhe, aane crawl/index karo." Robots.txt: Google ne kehavu "Aa specific folder ke URL path par crawl na karo (Disallow)."

Pehla webmaster ne manual removal request karvi. Remove na thay ane penalty risk hoy to j Google Disavow tool thi disavow file upload karvi. High-Impact Link Building Strategies: Strategic Guest Posting & Niche Edits Broken Link Building & Unlinked Brand Mentions Skyscraper Technique with data-driven assets Digital PR / HARO (Connectively) media outreach Competitor Backlink Gap Analysis Anchor Text Distribution Profile: Exact match anchor text over-optimize na karvo. t: 4. Modern Search: SEO vs AEO vs GEO & Content Strategy
Q: SEO, AEO ane GEO no difference su chhe?
x: Optimization Type Core Objective Primary Target Strategy Focus SEO (Search Engine Optimization) Rank in top organic search listings Search Engine Results Pages (SERPs) Keywords, Technical SEO, Backlinks, On-Page AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) Capture Position 0 & direct answers Featured Snippets, Voice Search (Siri/Alexa) Concisely structured answers, FAQ Schema GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) Secure citation in AI responses Gemini, ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews First-party data, E-E-A-T, Brand Entity authority Optimization Workflow for GEO & Helpful Content: BLUF Approach (Bottom Line Up Front): Provide the direct core answer within the first two sentences. t: Q: Jo 20,000 pages koi site ma hoy ane ee index na thay to tamaro step-by-step approach su rahe?
x: Google Search Console Deep-Dive Analysis: 'Discovered currently not indexed': Indicates crawl budget constraints, server response latency, or weak internal link hierarchy. 'Crawled currently not indexed': Points to perceived low content quality, thin content, or internal duplication. Excluded by noindex / Canonical mismatch: Technical directive misconfigurations. Technical Crawlability Checks: Audit robots.txt for unintended disallow rules. Analyze Time to First Byte (TTFB) and resolve intermittent 5xx server failures. XML Sitemap Segmentation: Segment 20,000 pages into smaller sitemaps of 1,000–2,000 URLs grouped by category or directory to isolate indexation drop-offs. Internal Link Architecture: Pass link equity from high-authority pages using contextual internal links, optimized breadcrumb paths, and static HTML sitemaps to resolve orphan pages.

t: Q: Koi new website hoy to tame kai rite SEO start karo ane ketlo time estimate thay?
x: Month 1: Foundation & Technical Setup Console setups (GSC, GA4), core technical site audit, domain structure planning, entity branding profiles creation. Month 2: Low-Hanging Fruit Execution Targeting long-tail keywords (KD < 25), structural core service page optimization, search intent mapping. Month 3: Topical Authority & Hub-and-Spoke Content Deployment of E-E-A-T rich pillar pages, supporting clusters, schema integration, and internal link routing. Month 4+: Authority Building & Scale Scaled Digital PR outreach, acquiring high-relevance niche backlinks, continuous content refresh cycles. Realistic Timeline Expectations: 1–3 Months: Technical indexation stabilized, initial impression growth, early long-tail keyword visibility. 3–6 Months: Medium-competition terms reaching positions 10–20, steady influx of qualified organic traffic. 6–12 Months: Competitive money terms entering Top 10, compounding organic conversion growth.

t: Q: US / International site male (B2B athava B2C) to tamari strategy su rahe?
x: International Technical Architecture: Precision hreflang tag deployment (en-US, en-GB, en-CA). US-hosted CDN/Server infrastructure for optimized latency. Region-specific currency ($) display and localized schema properties. B2B Strategic Focus: Focus on Bottom-of-Funnel (BOFU) transactional intent. High-value content assets: In-depth case studies, whitepapers, direct product comparison pages, ROI calculation tools. Primary Conversions: Qualified Sales Leads (MQLs/SQLs), live demo bookings. B2C Strategic Focus: High-intent transactional conversion paths, visual content optimization, rich Product schema (price, availability, aggregateRating). Primary Conversions: E-commerce direct sales, Average Order Value (AOV), ROAS maximization. US Market Outreach: High-tier Digital PR and editorial link acquisition from regional industry publications instead of standard web directory submissions.

t: Q: Blue Bottle sell karvi hoy ane Google Top 10 ma rank karavvi hoy to strategy su rese?
x: Buyer-Intent Long-Tail Targeting: Target precise long-tail queries like "insulated matte blue stainless steel gym bottle 1 litre" alongside broader terms. Advanced Product Schema Markup: Implement complete Product, Offer, AggregateRating, and InStock rich snippet structured data. Topical Authority Content Clusters: Publish supporting informational content (e.g., "Stainless Steel vs Plastic Water Bottles") driving internal page rank to the main product page. Google Merchant Center Integration: Configure optimized Google Merchant Center product feeds to capture organic shopping tab placements. User-Generated Content (UGC) & Off-Page Social Proof: Integrate verified customer reviews featuring user images to maximize E-E-A-T signals, paired with lifestyle blog outreach.

t: Q: Koi domain 1 month ma off thavanu hoy ane navi site par transfer karvanu hoy, to DA/PA ane traffic maintain karva su karso?
x: Direct 1-to-1 URL Mapping Matrix: Map every single historical, traffic-generating legacy URL to its exact structural equivalent on the new domain (avoid blanket homepage redirects). Staging & Environment Verification: Complete full site architecture setup, assets, and self-referential canonical tags on the new domain before site migration. Page-Level 301 Permanent Redirects: Apply server-level (.htaccess or Cloudflare edge level) 1-to-1 301 redirects to transfer 90–95% of accrued link juice. Google Search Console Change of Address: Execute the official Change of Address tool within GSC and submit the updated XML sitemap immediately post-launch. Infrastructure Continuity: Maintain active registration and hosting for the old domain for a minimum of 6–12 months to allow search engines to consolidate redirect signals.

t: Q: DA (Domain Authority) ane PA (Page Authority) vadharva mate su strategy use karo cho?
x: Expert Note: DA and PA are third-party metrics developed by Moz. Search engines operate on internal algorithms like Google PageRank and Topical Authority models. Execution Framework: High-Authority Relevance: Earn contextually relevant backlinks via targeted Digital PR campaigns and competitor link gap analysis. Spam Cleanups: Perform continuous backlink profile audits to mitigate incoming link toxic risks. Strategic PageRank Passing: Use contextual internal linking to funnel equity from high-authority informational blog posts to high-value money pages. Broken Link Reclamation: Identify inbound traffic pointing to dead 404 pages and recover value via strategic 301 redirects. Link Magnet Asset Creation: Produce data-driven reports, comprehensive industry statistics, and infographics that naturally earn editorially placed backlinks.

Aa doc kevi rite vaparvu Navo project aave etle aa doc ni ek copy banavo, uper client nu naam ane date lakho, pachhi Phase 0 thi niche sudhi order-wise follow karo. box ma kaam pura thay etle tick karo. Phase 1 (Baseline) sauthi important chhe — koi pan kaam start karta pehla bharo. Aaje website kya chhe te lock kari devu, jethi 3–6 mahina pachhi "pehla aavu hatu, have aavu chhe" batavi sakay. Har phase saathe rough time estimate aapel chhe (site size par depend kare). Badhu badhi site par lagu nathi padtu — client no type joine (ecommerce / service / local) je lagu pade te j karo. Order ni logic Pehla client access, pachhi baseline, pachhi audit, pachhi research, pachhi strategy. Aa flow follow karso to kadi confuse nahi thao. PHASE 0 — Client Info & Access Goal: client, business ane goal samjva + badha access ek saathe levaa. (Actual kaam 2–4 kalak, pan access aavta 2–4 divas jaay.) 0.1 Client Basic Info Business name + website URL Industry / niche Business type: Ecommerce / Service / Local / SaaS / Blog Contact person + WhatsApp/email Decision maker kon? (changes kon approve karse) Platform/CMS: Shopify / WordPress / Wix / Custom Target area: local city / national / international Languages 0.2 Business Understanding (loko aa skip kare — pan sauthi important) Su vechay chhe / kai service? (top 3 money product/service) USP — client bija karta su alag? Ideal customer kon? (location, problem, budget) Average order value / lead value (ROI samajva mate) Seasonality? (koi mahina ma sales vadhe/ghate) [Added] Related SOP: 01 Client Ask (R&D) → 01 Business Goal, 02 Target Customer, 03 USP, 04 Customer Problem 0.3 SEO Goals (spashta ane number ma) Main goal: Leads / Sales / Traffic / Brand / Rankings — kayu? Success ni definition: dakhla tarike "6 mahina ma organic leads double" Timeline expectation Budget (content, tools, backlinks) Realistic expectation set karo — SEO 3–6 mahine result aape, overnight nahi Senior note Goal vague hoy ("traffic vadharvu") to project fail thavaano risk. Number ma convert karavo, nahi to result mapva nu koi base nahi rahe. 0.4 Competitor Info (client pase thi) Client na hisaab e 3–5 business competitors kon? Note: aa SEO competitors thi alag hoy sake — real SEO competitor Phase 3 ma SERP par thi nakki karis 0.5 Previous SEO History (chhupela problems ahi thi male) Pehla koi agency/freelancer e kaam karyu? Su karyu? Koi manual penalty ke moto traffic drop history? Pehla backlink building thayu? (spammy links no risk) Recent redesign / migration / URL change thayu? Koi Google update thi affect thayu lage chhe? [Added] Related SOP: 10 Reporting & Maintenance → 02 Traffic Drop Diagnosis; 08 Technical SEO → 07 Website Redesign & Migration SEO 0.6 Access Collection (badha ek saathe mango, delay avoid) Google Search Console (GSC) Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Google Tag

﻿Business Goal samajvu Client Ask (R&D) no pehlo point. Koi pan website par kaam chalu karta pehla client no main goal clear hovo joiye - bija badha decisions (keywords, design, content) aa goal par j depend kare chhe. Kema important? Goal vagar SEO karo to traffic aave pan business ne faydo na thay. Example: client ne leads joiye ane tame blog traffic vadharo - traffic aavyu, inquiry nahi. Etle pehla goal, pachhi strategy. Client ne aa questions puchho Main goal su chhe? Sales (ecommerce), Leads/inquiries (service), ya Branding/awareness? Business model su chhe? B2B (business ne vechay) ke B2C (direct customer ne)? Revenue kya thi aave chhe? Kaya product/service thi sauthi vadhare kamai thay chhe? 6-12 mahina ma su achieve karvu chhe? Number ma - da. 100 leads/month, 2x sales. Atyare marketing kya thi chale chhe? Instagram, ads, referral, offline? Success kevi rite mapse? Calls, form fills, orders, store visits? Checklist Main goal ek vakya ma lakhelu chhe B2B ke B2C clear chhe Success na numbers fix chhe Goal na adhare j aagal nu planning thay chhe Khas Tip Client bole "badhu j joiye" to priority puchho: "Jo next 3 mahina ma fakt ek j vastu improve thay, te kayi?" - te j real goal chhe.

﻿Target Customer & Location Customer kon chhe ane kya chhe - be vastu clear hoy to j sacha keywords, content ane design bane. Generic website badha mate, pan sales targeted website thi j aave. Customer Persona banavo Kon chhe? Umar group, gender, job, aavak nu level. Online shu search kare chhe? Customer Google ma su lakhe te exact words note karo. Temni samasya (problem) su chhe? Je solution mate te search kare chhe. Kya decision le chhe? Mobile par ke laptop? WhatsApp ke email? Location decide karo Local dhando (salon, repair, classes): city + area keywords, Google Business Profile jaruri chhe. India-level (India ecom/services): India-first keywords, Hindi/Gujarati/English mix content kaam kare chhe. International (US/UK clients): English content, tya ni spelling (color vs colour), tya na competitors check karo. Udaharan Surat ni bakery: target = Surat na 20-45 varas na loko, birthday/eggless cake search karta. Keywords: "eggless cake surat", "birthday cake delivery surat". USA client nu software: target = US small business owners, keywords in English, competitor US-based. Checklist 1 clear customer persona lakhyo chhe Location: local / India / international decide karel chhe Customer na exact search words collect karela chhe

﻿USP Uniqueness shodho USP etle Unique Selling Point - tamara client ma aevu su chhe je competitor ma nathi? USP clear hoy to title, content ane ads badha sharp bane. USP na hoy to website "beeja jevi j" lage ane Google pan ene special rank nahi aape. USP kevi rite shodho Top 5 competitors ni website kholo ane temna homepage na main claims note karo. Su offer kare chhe je bija nahi karta? Free delivery, same-day service, 10 varas experience, lowest price, handmade, warranty? Customers sauthi vadhare su vakhan kare chhe? Reviews vanchi ne pattern shodho. Client ne seedho puchho: "Customer tamne j kema pasand kare chhe?" USP ne kya vaparvo Homepage na H1 ane title ma Meta description ma (CTR vadharva) Product/service pages na first paragraph ma Schema ma (Offer, priceRange) Example Bija badha jewellers "best designs" lakhe chhe. Jo client 100% BIS hallmark ane lifetime exchange aape chhe - te j USP chhe. Homepage par "BIS Hallmark Gold | Lifetime Exchange" bolu joiye, "Welcome to our website" nahi. Checklist 1 main USP + 2 supporting USP lakhela chhe USP homepage na H1/title ma dekhay chhe USP competitor na claims thi different chhe (copy nathi)

﻿Customer Problem & Solution Customer koi product nahi, potani problem nu solution search kare chhe. Jo website problem first address kare ane pachhi solution aape, to Google ma pan rank saru male ane conversion pan. Problem kevi rite shodho Customer reviews vanchho - client na ane competitor na be. Loko su complain kare chhe? Google "People Also Ask" ma keyword lakhine juvo - te real problems chhe. Quora/Reddit/YouTube comments ma niche na prashno juvo. Client ne puchho: "Customer phone par sauthi vadhare su puche chhe?" Problem thi Solution nu mapping Har problem mate ek answer: Problem = blog topic / FAQ question Solution = service/product page content Example: "cake delivery late thay chhe" problem → "Same-day cake delivery in Surat - order before 4 PM" page Aa data kya vaparvu FAQ section (AEO/GEO mate pan best) Blog topics - problem keywords long-tail hoy, rank karva easy Service page headings ma customer nu j word vapru Checklist Top 10 customer problems ni list chhe Har problem nu solution page/blog ma mapped chhe FAQ ma real customer questions add karela chhe

t: [6] 02 Domain Research & Selection/01 Keyword Volume Research
x: ﻿Keyword Volume Research Domain ke website mate saacho keyword shodhvo etle foundation. Keyword ni search volume (ketla loko mahine search kare) ane difficulty (rank karvu ketlu hard) be jovo padse. Steps Seed keywords lakho: business sathe related 10-15 words/topics. Tool ma nakho: Google Keyword Planner (free), Ubersuggest, Ahrefs free tools, AnswerThePublic. Semrush hoy to best. Volume Difficulty note karo: High volume (vadhu search) + Low KD (Keyword Difficulty, ochi) = best target. Long-tail prefer karo: 3+ words vala keywords (da. "eggless cake delivery surat") - volume ochu pan rank easy ane buyer intent high. Intent check karo: keyword informational (blog mate) chhe ke transactional (product/service page mate)? Practical rule Navi site: KD 0-30 vala keywords thi chalu karo Volume 50-500/month pan chale jo intent strong hoy Ek page = ek primary keyword + 3-5 secondary keywords Example "cake" (volume bahu high, KD high - skip karo). "eggless chocolate cake surat" (volume 200, KD low - target karo!). Checklist 20-30 keywords ni list volume + KD sathe ready Har keyword nu intent (info/buy) marked chhe Easy long-tail keywords pehla target ma chhe [Added] Nava page mate full 7-step process ane 5 final checks: 02 Domain Research → 07 Keyword Research Guide (Nava Page mate).

t: [7] 02 Domain Research & Selection/02 Competitor Pool Analysis
x: ﻿Competitor Pool Analysis Tamara top competitors juvo etle shortcut: te loko shu rank kare chhe, su lakhe chhe, kya thi backlinks le chhe - badhu free ma roadmap male. Steps Top 3-5 competitors shodho: main keyword Google ma search karo - first page par je consistency sathe dekhay te j real competitors. Temna top pages note karo: kaya pages sauthi vadhare traffic lave chhe (Ubersuggest/Semrush free trial). Temna keywords juvo: kaya keywords par rank kare chhe je tamara pase nathi te gap list chhe. Content style juvo: ketlu lamba articles, images, videos, FAQ structure, schema. Backlink sources note karo: kya sites temne link kare chhe - je relevant sites (directories, associations, PR, suppliers) tamne pan naturally link aapi shake te target list ma lo; paid/spam placements skip. Pool mathi su levu Je temna ma chhe pan tamara ma nathi (features, pages, topics) Temni weakness (slow site, old content, no FAQ) - tya jeeto Temna best content thi 10x better content banavvo Checklist 3-5 competitors ni list + notes chhe Keyword gap list banavi chhe Temna 3 strengths ane 3 weaknesses lakhela chhe

t: [8] 02 Domain Research & Selection/03 Target Country Selection
x: ﻿Target Country Selection Kaya country ne target karvu te pehla decide karo - keywords, content language, currency, examples badhu aena par depend kare chhe. Nirnay na factors Customer kya chhe? (Client Ask na point 2 juvo) Kaya country ma competition ocho ane budget fit? India ma CPC ochu, US ma high - pan US customers nu ticket size motu. Product/service shipping ke service possible chhe? Physical product ma delivery area j check karo. Payment ane language ready? US target to USD, card payments, English content. Amal Local: city name keywords + Google Business Profile + local listings India: India-first keywords, pricing INR ma, Indian examples ane payment options International: hreflang (jo multiple countries), country-specific domain ke subfolder (/us/), tya na competitors benchmark Udaharan Priyank nu rule Wibestone mate: "First priority India, then US and UK". Aetle keywords India volume pramane, pachhi US/UK pages alag optimize. Checklist Primary country fix chhe (1st priority) Secondary countries listed chhe Content language/currency country pramane set chhe

t: [9] 02 Domain Research & Selection/04 Quick Win Finding
x: ﻿Quick Win Finding Quick win etle aevi opportunities je ocha effort ma jaldi result aape. Navi site par 3-6 mahina lage, pan quick wins 2-4 week ma movement batave. Quick wins kevi rite shodho Position 5-20 vala pages: Search Console ma juvo kaya keywords par page 5-20 position par chhe - title, description, content thodu improve karo ne top 5 ma aavi shake. Low KD + sara volume keywords: je competitors e miss karela. People Also Ask na questions: FAQ add karo ne featured snippet male. Zero-click sudhara: title/description CTR improve karo - same position par pan traffic vadhare. Orphan ane thin pages fix karo: je pages ne koi link nathi, tene link aapo. Priority nakki karvanu formula Quick win = (saru potential traffic) x (ochu effort). Pehla te karo je 1 kalak ma thay ane 30 divas ma result batave. Checklist Search Console mathi top 10 opportunity pages listed 5 low-KD keywords pasand karela Dar quick win mate owner ane deadline fix chhe

t: [10] 02 Domain Research & Selection/05 6 Month Planning & Execution
x: ﻿6 Month Planning & Execution SEO marathon chhe, sprint nahi. 6 mahina nu realistic plan banavvo etle client pan wait kare ane kaam pan systematic chale. Mahina-pramane plan Month 1: Full audit (on-page, technical, content) karo, quick wins implement karo, GSC/GA4 setup verify karo. Month 2: On-page fixes (title, meta, headings, internal links) karo, must-have pages complete karo. Month 3: Content engine chalu - week ma 2-4 blogs, keyword gap cover karva. Month 4: Off-page chalu - backlinks, Reddit/Quora, social signals. Month 5: Content update (old pages refresh), schema ane AEO/GEO optimization. Month 6: Review - su work karyu, su nahi. Double down on working pages, strategy adjust. Tracking Dar mahine: impressions, clicks, position (GSC), users (GA4), leads/sales note karo Apeksha: Mahina 1-2 ma flat, Mahina 3-4 ma movement, Mahina 5-6 ma visible growth Checklist 6 mahina nu written plan chhe Monthly metrics track thay chhe Client ne timeline pehle divas e j samjavi chhe

t: [11] 02 Domain Research & Selection/06 Domain Name Finding Strategy
x: ﻿Domain Name Finding Strategy Saru domain name = brand nu foundation. Lamba term ma SEO, branding ane marketing badha ma faydo kare. 3 rules (notebook pramane) Keyword pramane: main keyword domain ma hoy to relevance signal male (da. "suratcakes.in"). Pan exact-match domain par over-optimize nahi - brand + keyword mix best. Country pramane: India target to .in, global to .com. Local trust mate country domain better rank kare te country ma. Yaad rakhva easy: 2-3 words max, spelling easy, phone par bolva ma samjay aevu, no hyphens/numbers jo avoid thay to. Check karvana steps Namecheap/GoDaddy ma availability check karo Same name Instagram/Facebook/YouTube handle ma pan male te juvo Google ma name search karo - koi existing brand/negative result to nahi? Trademark conflict to nahi (India ma ipindia.gov.in) Example "RadhaVision Infotech" - brand name short, yaad rahi jay evu, .com available, social handles same. Ekdam perfect combination. Checklist Short (2-3 words), spell-easy, bolva-easy Sachu extension (.com / .in) Social handles available chhe Trademark conflict nathi

t: [12] 02 Domain Research & Selection/07 Keyword Research Guide (Nava Page mate)
x: ﻿Keyword Research Guide — Nava Page mate Keyword kevi rite Pick karvu Priyank Diyora · 30 September 2026 · Semrush thi detail process: 03 Strategy → 06 Semrush Keyword to Content SOP [Added] Team standard Keyword data mate team no main tool Semrush chhe (Global Business Submission SOP pramane). Existing site hoy to pehla GSC juo — e real data chhe. Niche na free tools tyare vaparo jyare Semrush na hoy ke quick idea joiye. Keyword etle shu Keyword etle e exact shabd ke phrase je loko Google ma type kare chhe. Tamara page nu content e search sathe match thay, to Google e page ne result ma batave chhe. Ek example: koi Google ma type kare "ghar par easy science experiment" — aakhu e vakya j keyword chhe, fakt "science" nahi. Ek vaat yaad rakho: keyword e fakt shabd nathi, e user ni need chhe. Same shabd pachhal alag-alag need hoi shake — "laptop" search karnar koi kharidva mange chhe, koi fakt compare karva mange chhe. Etle shabd ni sathe e need (search intent) pan jovi padshe. Keyword kem important chhe Keyword nakki kare chhe ke page kona mate lakhayu chhe. Keyword focus vagar page lakho to page kai search mate chhe e clear nathi rahetu — Google ane users banne mate. Sacha loko aave chhe — je user ne kharekhar tamari service ke content joiye chhe e j aave, etle bounce ochho ane conversion vadhu. Free traffic — ek vaar rank thay pachhi ad kharcha vagar mahino-mahino traffic aave. Content ne disha male — keyword khabar hoy to shu lakhvu, ketlu lakhvu, kaya subtopic cover karva e badhu clear thai jay. Page-page vachche takrav na thay — dar page ne potano alag keyword aapo to be page ek-bija sathe competition nathi karta. Keyword na types Be rite type padta hoy chhe — lambai pramane ane intent (user ni need) pramane. Nava page mate banne jova padshe. t: [13] 03 Strategy/01 Quick Win - Title & Description (Top 4-10 Pages)
x: ﻿Quick Win - Top 4-10 Pages nu Title & Description Je pages Google ma position 4-10 par chhe (first page, pan top 3 ma nathi) - tenu title ane meta description improve karo. Aa sauthi fast ROI valo SEO move chhe: content change karva jevu effort nahi, pan CTR ane ranking banne improve thay. Steps Search Console kholo → Performance → Pages. Position 4-10 vala pages filter karo. Impressions vadhare, CTR ocho vala pages pehla select karo - title/description no j problem chhe. Title rewrite karo: primary keyword first, number/power word add karo (da. "2026", "Best", "Guide", "Free"), 50-60 characters. Description rewrite karo: benefit + CTA + keyword, 150-160 characters. Question format CTR vadharave (da. "Looking for X?"). 2-4 week wait karo ane CTR/position compare karo. Title formulas je work kare [Number] [Keyword] + [Benefit] → "7 Eggless Cake Designs je Surat ma Famous chhe" [Keyword] [Year] + [Brand] → "SEO SOP 2026 | RadhaVision" How to + [Keyword] + [Result] → "How to Choose Domain Name je Rank kare" Checklist Top 4-10 position vala pages identify karya (GSC) Title: keyword pehla, 50-60 chars, power word Description: faydo + CTA, 150-160 chars Changes na dates noted (before/after compare karva)

﻿10-20 Pages nu Content Improvement Position 10-20 (second page) vala pages ne top 10 ma lavva mate title patse nahi - content j improve karvu padshe. Second page = Google page ne relevant mane chhe pan enough quality/depth nathi. Steps (pagla) GSC ma position 10-20 vala pages shodho. Top 3 competitor pages vanchho same keyword mate - temna ma su chhe je tamara ma nathi? Content depth vadharo: missing subtopics add karo ane navu value (data, examples, experience) - word count target nahi. Structure improve karo: H2/H3 proper hierarchy, FAQ section add karo, internal links add karo (3-5). Freshness signal: date update, new examples, latest data add karo. Media add karo: images, screenshots, tables - text-only pages harai jay chhe. Kayu pan check karvu Page target keyword nu intent satisfy kare chhe? (Informational query par product page hoy to flip karo) Core Web Vitals pass chhe? (On-Page point 4 juvo) Page ne internal links male chhe? Na hoy to 2-3 relevant internal links aapo; trusted sources ne 1-2 outbound citations; backlinks mate Off-Page SOP juo Checklist 10-20 position vala pages ni list taiyar Competitor comparison complete (shu missing chhe te list karo) Depth structure + freshness improves karela 1 month ma position re-check scheduled

﻿Competitor Gap + Keyword Gap Competitors je keywords par rank kare chhe ane tame nahi - te list j tamari next 3-6 mahina ni content strategy chhe. Gap analysis = ready-made roadmap. Steps (pagla) Tool select karo: Semrush (Keyword Gap tool), Ahrefs (Content Gap), ke free option - Ubersuggest + manual Google search. Tamaru domain vs 3-4 competitors enter karo. Filter: competitors top 20 ma, tame 50+ ke absent - te keywords export karo. Cluster karo: similar keywords ne group karo - ek group = ek page/blog (keyword cannibalization avoid karva). Priority set karo: Volume x (1/KD) x business relevance - je highest te pehla. Manual method (tool vagar) Main keyword search karo, competitor na top pages open karo, temna H2/H3 topics note karo - tame cover karel nathi te gap chhe Google "People Also Ask" ane "Related Searches" manually note karo (ke Semrush Questions / AlsoAsked jeva tools) - automated scraping nahi Output nu format Sheet: Keyword | Volume | KD | Competitor ranking | Tamari status | Priority | Target page Checklist Gap keyword sheet taiyar chhe (50+ keywords) Clusters banavela (ek cluster = ek page) Next content batch mate Top 10 priorities select karela chhe

﻿Blog Strategy (Category thi Blog sudhi) Blog = long-tail keywords, internal linking ane EEAT nu engine. Pan random blogs nahi - category/product sathe linked blogs j sales lave. (Aa point ma Priyank na juna "Ecommerce Blog SEO Workflow" doc nu merge karel chhe.) 3-Step Blog Workflow (puri detail + rules + example: 03 Strategy → 07 Ecommerce Blog Workflow) Step 1 - Title: Category page, tena products, GSC queries ane People Also Ask joi ne 8-10 blog titles jate shortlist karo, pachhi client/manager pase review karavo. Pehla title nakki thay to j sacha products ane keywords male. Step 2 - Products + Keywords: Final title par website mathi j Top 5 products ane target keywords levo - sacha internal links sales lave. Step 3 - Final Blog: Title + products + keywords + rules saathe blog lakhavo. Blog rules (koi pan website type mate) Har blog ek problem/question solve kare (search intent clear) Length: topic fully cover karo - word count ranking factor nathi; competitors thi vadhare useful banavo (navu data, examples, experience) Har blog ma 3-5 internal links (related products/pages/blogs) FAQ section end ma (AEO/GEO mate) Real images/examples vapro - stock photos ochha ma ochha vapro Publishing ni frequency Navi site: week ma 2-4 blogs consistent (quality over quantity) Juna blogs dar 6 mahine review karo - outdated hoy ke traffic ghatyu hoy to refresh (ranking ni guarantee nahi) Blog → category page link jaruri (sales flow) Checklist Blog topics category/products sathe linked chhe 3-step workflow follow thay chhe (title → products/keywords → final) Har blog ma internal links + FAQ chhe Cadence fixed ane calendar ma chhe

﻿Content Calendar (Extra Point - Instinct added) Random kabhi pan publish karva thi Google confuse nahi thay, pan consistent cadence thi topical authority speed ma bane. Content calendar = discipline + planning. Simple calendar nu structure Week 1-2: Money pages pehla (service/product/category pages) Week 3-4: Supporting blogs je money pages ne link kare Ongoing: Week ma 2-4 pieces, same days (da. Mon + Thu) Calendar columns (Sheet ma) Date | Topic | Target keyword | Intent | Type (page/blog) | Internal links | Status | Published URL Topic sources (kadi topic khatam nahi thay) Keyword gap sheet (Strategy point 3) People Also Ask + Related Searches Customer na questions (Client Ask point 4) Seasonal events (festival, sale seasons - 1 month pehla publish) Competitor na new posts Checklist 1 mahina nu calendar pehla tyaar Money pages pehla, supporting blogs pachhi Seasonal content 1 month advance ma

t: [18] 03 Strategy/06 Semrush Keyword to Content SOP
x: ﻿Semrush Keyword to Content SOP Version 1.1 | Nov 2026 | Blog, Category, Collection, Service — badha page type mate Aa SOP no goal: koi pan team member (fresher hoy to pan) ek seed keyword thi sharu kari ne — keyword research, clustering, mapping, SERP analysis, content brief, internal linking ane measurement — same proper process thi kari sake. Pehla 3 imandar vaat (vanchya vagar SOP use na karvi) Koi pan SOP 'super rank guaranteed' nathi aapti. Ranking ma content quality, site authority (backlinks), technical health, intent match ane competition — badhu kaam kare chhe. Aa SOP tamaru chance khub vadhare chhe, guarantee nahi. Original notes ma "competitor no content 90% same rakho, slug 10% change karo" lakhyu hatu — aa step SOP mathi kaadhi nakhyu chhe. Google na spam policies ma 'scraped content' ane 'scaled content abuse' clearly che: biji site no content thoda badlav sathe republish karvo, ke 2-3 sites nu content jodi ne kai navu add na karvu = spam. Primary secondary keyword map. Supporting blog topics → blog plan. Contextual internal links → link map. Off-page anchor mix → off-page sheet. Execute badhu kaam track karo. t: [21] 04 Design & Web Development/01 UI-UX Human Feel (AI-made na lage)
x: ﻿UI/UX AI-made na lage aevu design 2026 ma AI websites same-look thai gay chhe - same gradients, same layout, robotic text. User 3 second ma identify kari jay ane trust ghate. Human feel = easy to read + natural flow. Notebook na points Vanchvama easy: body text no font size 16px+, line height 1.5+, contrast strong rakho (white par light gray text = fail). Bad paragraphs avoid karo: lamba 10-line paragraphs nahi. 2-4 lines nu paragraph, vachche subheadings, bullet lists. AI text patterns avoid karo: "In today's fast-paced world", "delve into", "unlock the power" - aa words dekhata j user jaani jay. Simple, direct bhasha lakho. Human feel mate Real photos (team, office, products) - stock images minimum rakho Real customer na words (reviews, testimonials names sathe) Brand nu consistent voice (formal/friendly - pan consistent) Whitespaces screen bharelu na dekhay Test Page ne 5 second juvo ane pucho: "Aa page su kehve chhe?" Answer na male to redesign. Checklist Font 16px+, contrast pass, 2-4 line na paragraphs AI-typical words hataavela Real photos/testimonials present chhe 5-second clarity test pass thayelo

Speed mobile par Images WebP format ma compress karela 4G connection par 3 second ma load thavu joiye (PageSpeed Insights mobile score check) Real device test (jaruri) Emulator perfect batave pan real phone ma issues hoy. 1 Android + 1 iPhone ma kholi ne juvo: menu khule? Forms fill thay? Buttons dabay? Checklist Mobile par Core Web Vitals pass (Lighthouse 90+ goal) Real device test thai gayo (Android + iPhone) Mobile par intrusive popups na hova joiye Badha forms/buttons thumb-friendly hova joiye

t: [26] 05 On-Page SEO/01 EEAT on All Pages

﻿Robots.txt & Sitemap Properly Robots.txt Google ne kahe chhe su crawl karvu ane su nahi. Sitemap.xml Google ne site na badha pages nu map aape chhe. Banne technical SEO nu base chhe - kharab robots.txt important pages ne crawl thi roki shake; sitemap index ni guarantee nathi aaptu, pan discovery fast kare. Robots.txt na niyamo Location: domain.com/robots.txt ma accessible hovu joiye. Crawl block karo: admin pages, cart, checkout, internal search result pages. Duplicate/filter URLs ane thank-you pages mate pehla canonical/noindex vaparo — robots.txt block fakt crawl waste motu hoy tyare (ane index mathi nikli gaya pachhi). Kyarey block na karo: CSS/JS files (Google render karvu joiye), main content pages. Sitemap line add karo: Sitemap: https://domain.com/sitemap.xml Sitemap na niyamo Generate karo: WordPress ma Yoast/RankMath auto-banave; custom site ma generator tool. Fakt 200-status, canonical URLs sitemap ma hova joiye - no 404s, no redirects, no noindex pages. Submit karo: Google Search Console → Sitemaps → submit. Bing Webmaster Tools ma pan. Update automatic hovu joiye new page add thay tyare. Common mistakes (aa bhool na karo) "Disallow: /" staging ma hoy ane live site par j reh jay - site deindex! Dead URLs sathe nu old sitemap Sitemap submit karel pan GSC ma errors check na karela Checklist robots.txt accessible ane sitemap line sathe Admin/cart/search pages block karela, content pages open Sitemap GSC + Bing ma submit karel chhe, koi errors nathi New pages sitemap ma auto-add thay

t: [28] 05 On-Page SEO/03 Internal Linking (3-5 Per Page)

Notebook rule: har page par 3-5 internal links minimum. Rules (niyamo) Darek page par 3-5 contextual links: content ma naturally fit thay aeva - footer/sidebar na links count ma nathi. Varietybharyu anchor text: "click here" nahi - "eggless cake delivery in Surat" jevu keyword-rich text. Hierarchy no flow: Blog → Category → Product/Service (money pages taraf authority flow). Deep pages ne pan link: fakt homepage/popular pages ne j nahi - nava ane deep pages ne pan. Anchor text ma variety: same page ne link karva different-different natural anchors use karo. Structure nu example Homepage → Category pages → Product pages (parent-child sambandh) Blog "10 cake designs" mathi "chocolate truffle cake" product page ne link karo (contextual) Related blogs ek bija ne link kare (topic cluster) Checklist Har page par 3-5 contextual internal links Descriptive anchor text use karelu chhe Money pages ne most internal links male chhe Koi broken internal links nathi (dar mahine crawl check)

t: [29] 05 On-Page SEO/04 Page Speed & Core Web Vitals
x: ﻿Page Speed & Core Web Vitals (PageSpeed Insights) Notebook rule: "PageSpeed Insight no use karine 90 ni upar hoy joiye". Slow site = users pacha jay ane sales ghate; Core Web Vitals Google na page experience signals no bhaag chhe (ranking ma nano factor, content pehla). Kevi rite check karvu pagespeed.web.dev ma URL nakho Mobile score juvo pehla (desktop score misleading hoy) Main target: Core Web Vitals "Good" — real users nu data (GSC → Core Web Vitals report / PSI field data): LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1. PSI score 90+ = saro goal, ranking rule nahi (Shopify par mobile 60–80 hoy pan CWV pass hoy to chale). Common fixes (sauthi vadhare impact vala pehla) Images optimize karo: WebP format, compressed (TinyPNG), lazy loading (fold niche ni images j — main/LCP image lazy nahi), yogya dimensions Caching on rakho: browser + server caching (WP ma WP Rocket/LiteSpeed) JS/CSS minimize karo: unused plugins remove karo, minify karo, non-critical JS defer karo Hosting upgrade karo: cheap shared hosting thi server response slow thay (TTFB < 600ms target) CDN use karo: Cloudflare free tier pan chale chhe Fonts limit: 2 fonts max, font-display: swap Lighthouse 4 categories (juna SOP doc mathi) Performance (speed ane loading) Accessibility Best Practices (shreshth paddhatio) SEO charma 90+ target rakho Checklist Key pages par Core Web Vitals pass (field data); Mobile PSI 90+ jo shakya hoy Core Web Vitals green (GSC ma pan check) Images WebP + lazy load karo Monthly re-test schedule karo

﻿No Orphan Pages Notebook (Gujarati): "Koi pan new page banavo to orphan page na rahe - jarur bija blog ma te te link kari do." Orphan page = jene site na koi pan page mathi link nahi miltu. Rule (niyam) Darek new page → tarat minimum 2-3 internal links: related blog mathi, category page mathi, ke related service page mathi. ﻿Slug = Keyword (URL Structure) Notebook point 8: "Slug all keyword + main". Slug = URL no last part. Clean, keyword-rich slug Google ne page nu topic instant samjave ane users ne pan trust aape. t: [35] 05 On-Page SEO/10 Keyword Mapping (Primary, Secondary, FAQ)
x: ﻿Keyword Mapping (Primary, Secondary, FAQ) Notebook point 9: "Primary - secondary FAQ all keywords properly follow in all pages". Har page ne clear keyword assignment hovi joiye - nahi to 2 pages same keyword mate fight kare (cannibalization) ane banna haray. Darek page mate 3-tier structure Primary keyword (1): page nu main target. Aa aama aave: title, H1, slug, first paragraph, meta description. Secondary keywords (3-5): sambandhit variations. Aama aave: H2s, body content, image alt. FAQ keywords (3-5): question format ma. FAQ section ma sidha jawab sathe aave. Mapping sheet banavo Columns: Page URL | Primary keyword | Secondary keywords | FAQ keywords | Search intent | Status Rule: 1 keyword = 1 page. Same keyword 2 pages par = problem. Keyword Placement (density nahi) Primary keyword title, H1, slug ane first paragraph ma aave - te enough chhe Keyword density Google no ranking factor nathi - % target set na karo Stuffing (same word vaar-vaar, unnatural) avoid karo - synonyms ane related terms naturally vapro. Example (cake site) Primary: "eggless cake delivery surat" Secondary: "eggless birthday cake", "same day cake delivery", "order cake online surat" FAQ: "eggless cake ketla divas fresh rahe?", "surat ma kaya area ma delivery chhe?" Old SEO vs New SEO (30 sec) Old: Google ma rank thavu ej game — keyword + backlink. New: Google + AI badhe retrieve + cite + trust thavu. Ek line: pehla "rank" j goal hato; have "AI cite kare" e pan goal chhe. Core idea (yaad rakho) AEO = user na question no direct answer FIRST aapo (long intro nahi). GEO = AI ne 4 vaat aapo — ENTITY (tame kon), ANSWER (question solve), ORIGINAL (navu useful info), TRUST (proof + reviews). Analogy Google = busy teacher. "Answer aa file ma chhe" bolo — story nahi. GEO = smart waiter: tamari info clear hoy to j tamne confidently recommend kare. Formulas AEO: ASK → ANSWER → FORMAT → PROVE → MEASURE GEO: ENTITY → ANSWER → ORIGINAL → TRUST → SOURCES → TEST PART B — KARVANU (blog/page par) 4. Format intent pramane: para / list / table / steps. H2 = follow-up questions (PAA): how long · what affects · how to support · when to see doctor. FAQ = real questions (fake nahi). Internal links → related page. (Article = island, link = bridge.) Schema = page type pramane accurate Article/Product markup (fake nahi). [Note: Google e 7 May 2026 thi FAQ rich results band karya chhe — FAQ section user mate rakho, FAQ schema optional.] Measure → GSC: impressions, clicks, CTR. ✕ Bad (answer chhupave) ✓ Good (answer first) "Piles is a common condition… various treatment options available…" "No. Piles medicine immediately kaam nathi karti; kalak–days lage, type/severity par depend." 5. t: 5. Architecture fix patterns (je sauthi common chhe)
x: Pattern 1: Flat dump Badha pages homepage niche direct (50+ links). Fix: 3–7 hub pages banavo, pages hubs niche move karo, homepage par fakta hubs. Pattern 2: Deep burial Money pages 4–6 clicks deep. Fix: homepage/hub thi direct link, related-products/posts widgets, footer links (important pages only). Pattern 3: Orphan blog posts Blogs publish thay pan kyathi link j nathi. Fix: hub/pillar pages banavo je badha blogs ne list kare + posts ma contextual links. Pattern 4: Cannibal clusters Ek j keyword par 3 pages. Fix: Master Keyword Map (02 → 07, section 8) sathe compare → best page rakho, baki 301 ke merge (10 → 03 decision rules). Pattern 5: Faceted nav bloat (ecommerce) Filter combinations e 1000s URLs banavi. Fix: canonical/noindex rules (09 → 03), sitemap ma fakta canonical URLs.
